z’Inama. PP-98 PP-02
58 (SUP) PP-06
59- 8 Umunyamabanga mukuru akora imirimo
y’Umunyamabanga w’Inama.
60- 9 Umunyamabanga mukuru,
Umunyamabanga mukuru wungirije hamwe
n’abayobozi b’ibiro bafite uburenganzira bwo
kugira uruhare mu gufata ibyemezo by ’Inama,
ariko ntibemerewe gutora. Icyakora, Inama
ishobora gukoresha inama zihuza gusa
abahagarariye ibihugu biyigize. PP-98
60A 9 bis) Igihugu kigize Umuryango kitari mu
bihugu bigize Inama gishobora, iyo
cyabimenyesheje Umunyamabanga mukuru,
kohereza indorerezi gikoresheje amikoro yacyo
mu nama z’Inama, iza komisiyo zayo ndetse
n’iz’amatsinda y’akazi yazo. Indorerezi ntabwo
igira uburenganzira bwo gutora. PP-98 PP-02
60B 9 ter) Abagize inzego bashobora kwitabira
inama zahujwe n’Inama, iza komisiyo zayo
n'iz’amatsinda y’akazi yazo nk'indorerezi
hakurikijwe ibisabwa bigenwa n'Inama, harimo
ibijyanye n'umubare w’indorerezi
n'amabwiriza agenga uburyo zigenwa. PP-02
PP-06
61-10 Inama isuzuma buri mwaka raporo
yakozwe n’ Umunyamabanga mukuru ku
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’igenamigambi
ryemejwe n’Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu byabo kandi ikamuha
umwanzuro ibona ko ukwiriye. PP-98
61A 10 bis) Igihe cyose, hashingiwe ku
mafaranga yateganyijwe nk’uko yemejwe
n’inama y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu byabo, Inama ishobora, bibaye
ngombwa, kongera gusuzuma no kuvugurura
igenamigambi nk’ishingiro rya gahunda
y’ibizakorwa bijyanye na ryo kandi
ikabimenyesha ibihugu bigize Umuryango
n’abagize inzego. PP-02
61B 10 ter) Inama yishyiriraho amategeko
ngengamikorere yayo. PP-02
62- 11 Inama igenzura, mu gihe kiri hagati
y’inama z’ ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu byabo, imicungire n’imiyoborere muri
rusange by’Umuryango, ishobora
by’umwihariko:
62A 1) kwakira kandi ikanasuzuma amakuru
ajyanye no gutegura igenamigambi atangwa
n'Umunyamabanga mukuru nk'uko bigaragara
muri nimero 74A y'Itegeko Shingiro kandi, mu
gihe cy’inteko isanzwe ya nyuma y’Inama
mbere y'Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
ikurikira, itangira gutegura umushinga
w’igenamigambi rishya ry’Umuryango,
ishingiye ku misanzu y’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango n’abagize inzego, kimwe
n’iy’amatsinda ngishwanama y’inzego, kandi
igakora umushinga wa nyuma
w’igenamigambi rishya bitarenze amezi ane
mbere y’Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu byabo; PP-02
62B 1 bis) gushyiraho ingengabihe yo gutegura
igenamigambi na gahunda y’imari
y’Umuryango ndetse na gahunda y’ibikorwa
bya buri rwego n’iz’ubunyamabanga bukuru
kugira ngo habeho guhuza neza izo gahunda;
PP-02
63-1 ter) kwemeza kandi ikavugurura
amabwiriza agenga abakozi n’amabwiriza
agenga imari y’Umuryango n’andi mabwiriza
ibona ko ari ngombwa, hashingiwe ku mikorere
y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ndetse n’ibigo
byihariye bikoresha gahunda rusange
y’imishahara, amafaranga agenerwa abakozi na
pansiyo.
64- 2) guhindura, bibaye ngombwa:
65 a) inzego z’imishahara fatizo ku bakozi bo
mu cyiciro cy’akazi k’umwuga n’abo mu
cyiciro cyo hejuru, havuyemo imishahara y’abo
mu myanya isaba ko habaho amatora,
hagamijwe kuzihuza n’inzego z’umushahara
fatizo washyizweho n’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye ku byiciro bihuye bya gahunda
rusange ;
66 b) inzego z’imishahara fatizo ku bakozi bo
mu cyiciro cya serivisi zisanzwe ku cyicaro
cy’Umuryango, mu rwego rwo kuzihuza
n’imishahara itangwa n’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye n’ibigo byihariye;
67 c) amafaranga agenerwa abakozi bo mu
cyiciro cy’akazi k’umwuga n’abo mu cyiciro
cyo hejuru, hakubiyemo imyanya isaba ko
habaho amatora, hakurikijwe ibyemezo
by’Umuryango w’Abibumbye kugira ngo
byubahirizwe ku cyicaro cy’Umuryango;
68 d) Amafaranga agenerwa abakozi ahabwa
umukozi wese w’Umuryango, ajyanye
n’impinduka izo ari zo zose zemejwe muri
gahunda rusange y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye;
69 3) ifata ibyemezo bikenewe kugira ngo
habeho isaranganya ry’akazi ringana rishingiye
ku turere mu bakozi b’Umuryango ndetse no ku
guhagararirwa k’umugore mu byiciro by’akazi
k’umwuga ndetse no byiciro byo hejuru ndetse
ikanagenzura ko ibyo byemezo byashyizwe mu
bikorwa. PP-98
70- 4) ifata umwanzuro wo kwemeza ibyifuzo
ku mpinduka zikomeye z’imitunganyirize mu
bunyamabanga bukuru n’ibiro by’inzego
z’Umuryango hakurikijwe Itegeko Shingiro
n’aya Masezerano, bishyikirizwa Inama
n’Umunyamabanga mukuru nyuma yo
gusumwa na Komite mpuzabikorwa;
71- 5) isuzuma kandi ikemeza gahunda zimara
imyaka myinshi zijyanye n’imyanya n'abakozi
ndetse na gahunda z’iterambere ry’abakozi
z’Umuryango kandi ikanatanga icyerekezo ku
bijyanye n’umubare w’abakozi, haba mu
bijyanye n’urwego cyangwa imirimo y’abo
bakozi, hitawe ku mabwiriza rusange y’Inama
y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
byabo hamwe n’ingingo bijyanye ziteganyijwe
mu ngingo ya 27 y’Itegeko Shingiro;
72 - 6) ihindura, iyo ari ngombwa, umusanzu
w’Umuryango n’abakozi utangwa mu kigega
cya pansiyo y’abakozi cy’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye hakurikijwe sitati n’amabwiriza
agenga iki kigega ndetse n’amafaranga yo
kubaho ahabwa abagenerwabikorwa b’ikigega
cy'ubwishingizi bw'abakozi cy'Umuryango,
bitewe n’uko gikora;
73- 7) isuzuma kandi ikemeza ingengo
y’imyaka ibiri y’Umuryango kandi igasuzuma
ingengo y’imari iteganyijwe (iboneka muri
raporo y’imicungire y’imari ikorwa
n’Umunyamabanga mukuru hakurikijwe
nimero ya 101 y’aya Masezerano) mu myaka
ibiri ikurikira igihe cy’ingengo y’imari
cyateganyijwe, hitabwa ku byemezo by’Inama
y’ababifitiye ububasha byerekeranye na nimero
ya 50 y’Itegeko Shingiro n’amafaranga
atarenga yateganyijwe n’Inama y’ababifitiye
ububasha hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri
nimero 51 y'Itegeko Shingiro; ikoresha uburyo
bwose bwo kuzigama, ariko izirikana
inshingano z’Umuryango zo kugaragaza
ibyakozwe ku rwego rushimishije kandi vuba
bishoboka. Mu kubikora, Inama izirikana
ibyihutirwa byagaragajwe n’Inama
y’ababifitiye ububasha, nk’uko bigaragara mu
igenamigambi ry’Umuryango, ibitekerezo bya
komite mpuzabikorwa nk'uko bigaragara muri
raporo y’Umunyamabanga mukuru ivugwa
muri nimero 86 y’aya Masezerano, hamwe na
raporo y’imicungire y’imari ivugwa muri
nimero 101 y’aya Masezerano. Inama ikora
isuzuma ngarukamwaka ku byinjira
n’ibisohoka kugira ngo igire icyo ihinduraho,
bibaye ngombwa, hakurikijwe imyanzuro
n’ibyemezo by’Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu byabo ; PP-98 PP-02 PP06
74- 8) ikora igenzura ngarukamwaka rya konti
z’Umuryango zakozwe n’Umunyamabanga
mukuru kandi ikazemeza, iyo hari aho
bikenewe, kugira ngo bishyikirizwe Inama
ikurikira y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu byabo;
75- 9) itegura ibikenerwa ngo hatumizwe inama
cyangwa inteko z’Umuryango kandi igaha
Ubunyamabanga bukuru n’inzego
by’Umuryango, byumvikanweho n’ibihugu
byinshi mu bigize Umuryango, iyo ari inama
cyangwa inteko ku isi, cyangwa ibihugu
byinshi mu bigize Umuryango biri muri ako
karere mu gihe ari inama mu karere, imirongo
ngenderwaho ikwiye ku bijyanye n’ubufasha
mu bya tekiniki n’ubundi bufasha mu gutegura
no gutunganya inama cyangwa inteko; PP-98
76- 10) ifata ibyemezo ku bijyanye na nimero
28 y’aya Masezerano;
77- 11) ifata icyemezo ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’ibyemezo ibyo ari byo byose byafashwe
n’inama n’ibyemezo bishobora kugira ingaruka
ku mikoreshereze y’amafaranga;
78- 12) uretse ibiteganywa n'Itegeko Shingiro,
aya Masezerano n'amabwiriza atangwa
n’ubuyobozi, ishobora gufata izindi ngamba
zose ibona ko zikenewe kugira ngo habeho
imikorere myiza y’Umuryango;
79 - 13) ifata ingamba izo ari zo zose zikenewe,
byumvikanweho n’ibihugu byinshi mu bigize
Umuryango, kugira ngo ikemure
by’agateganyo ibibazo bidateganyijwe mu
Itegeko Shingiro, muri aya Masezerano no mu
mabwiriza atangwa n’ubuyobozi kugira ngo
bikemuke, mu gihe bidashoboka gutegereza
inama ikurikira ibifitiye ububasha; PP-98 PP02
80- 14) ishinzwe ko habaho ubufatanyabikorwa
n’imiryango mpuzamahanga yose ivugwa mu
ngingo ya 49 na 50 y'Itegeko Shingiro. Kugira
ngo ibyo bishoboke, mu izina ry’Umuryango,
igirana amasezerano y’agateganyo n’imiryango
mpuzamahanga ivugwa mu ngingo ya 50
y’Itegeko Shingiro no muri nimero 269B na
269C y’aya Masezerano ndetse hamwe
n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye hashingiwe ku
masezerano hagati y’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye n’Umuryango mpuzamahanga
w’Itumanaho; ayo Masezerano y'agateganyo
ashyikirizwa Inama y'ababifitye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu byabo ikurikira
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya 8
y'Itegeko Shingiro; PP-94 PP-06
81-15) yoherereza ibihugu bigize Umuryango,
mu gihe cy’iminsi 30 nyuma ya buri nteko
yayo, incamake ku byakorewemo, hamwe
n’inyandiko zose ibona ko ari ngombwa; PP-98
PP-02
82-16) ishyikiriza Inama y’ababifitiye
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu byabo raporo
ku bikorwa by’ Umuryango kuva Inama
y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
byabo iheruka yaterana ndetse n’ibyifuzo ibyo
ari byo byose ibona ko bikwiye.
AGACE KA 3

articles.heading: Ubunyamabanga Bukuru 83 -1 Umunyamabanga mukuru
articles.text:
84- a) ashinzwe gucunga muri rusange
umutungo w’Umuryango; ashobora gusaba
Umunyamabanga wungirije ndetse
n’abayobozi b’inzego gucunga bimwe mu
bigize uwo mutungo, nyuma yo kugisha inama,
aho bikenewe, komite mpuzabikorwa;
85- b) ahuza ibikorwa by’Ubunyamabanga
bukuru n’inzego z’Umuryango, hitawe ku
bitekerezo bya Komite mpuzabikorwa,
hagamijwe ko hakoreshwa neza kandi mu
buryo budasesagura umutungo w’Umuryango;
86- c) ategura, abifashijwemo na Komite
mpuzabikorwa, kandi agashyikiriza Inama
raporo ku ihindagurika ry’imiterere
y’itumanaho kuva Inama y’ababifitiye
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu byabo iheruka
yaterana kandi ikubiyemo ibyifuzo bijyanye na
politiki n'ingamba ku hazaza h’Umuryango,
hamwe n’ingaruka zabyo zaturuka ku
mikoreshereze y’amafaranga; PP-98
86A c bis) akurikirana ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’igenamigambi ryemejwe n’Inama
y’ababifitiye ububasha kandi agategura raporo
y’umwaka y’uko byakozwe kugira ngo
isuzumwe n’Inama; PP-98
87 d) ategura imirimo y’Ubunyamabanga
bukuru kandi agashyiraho abakozi bakoramo,
akurikije amabwiriza yatanzwe n’Inama y’
ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
byabo n’amabwiriza yashyizweho n’Inama;
87A d bis) ategura buri mwaka gahunda
y’ibikorwa y’imyaka ine bizakorwa n'abakozi
b'Ubunyamabanga bukuru hakurikijwe
igenamigambi, ifata umwaka utaha n'imyaka
itatu ikurikira, hamwe n'ingaruka zaturuka mu
mikoreshereze y’amafaranga, hitawe kuri
gahunda y’imari nk’uko yemejwe n’Inama
y‘ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
byabo; iyo gahunda y’ibikorwa y’imyaka ine
isuzumwa n’amatsinda ngishwanama y’inzego
eshatu ndetse isuzumwa kandi ikemezwa buri
mwaka n’Inama; PP-98 PP-02
88 e) afatira ibyemezo by’ubuyobozi ibiro
by'inzego z’Umuryango kandi agashyiraho
abakozi b'ibiro hashingiwe ku guhitamo
n'ibyifuzo by'umuyobozi w’ibiro bireba, ariko
icyemezo cya nyuma cyo gushyiraho cyangwa
kwirukana umukozi gifatwa
n’Umunyamabanga mukuru;
89 f) amenyesha Inama ibyemezo ibyo ari byo
byose byafashwe n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye
n’inzego zihariye bishobora kugira ingaruka ku
mikorere ya serivisi, amafaranga agenerwa
abakozi na pansiyo bya gahunda rusange;
90 g) akurikirana ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry'amabwiriza ayo ari yo yose yemejwe
n'Inama;
91 h) agira inama Umuryango mu
by'amategeko;
92 i) agenzura, hagamijwe imicungire
y’ubuyobozi, abakozi b’Umuryango, kugira
ngo habeho gukoresha neza abo bakozi mu
buryo bushoboka kandi bakorerwe ibisabwa mu
kazi na gahunda rusange. Abakozi
bashyirirwaho gufasha abayobozi b’ibiro mu
buryo butaziguye bagenzurwa
n’Umunyamabanga mukuru kandi bagakora
ibyo basabwe n’abayobozi bireba, ariko
hakurikijwe amabwiriza agenga ubuyobozi
yatanzwe n’Inama ;
93 j) mu nyungu rusange z’Umuryango kandi
abigishijeho inama abayobozi b’ibiro bireba,
yohereza by'agateganyo abakozi ku yindi
myanya itari iyo bashinzwe nk’uko bikenewe
bitewe n’imihindagurikire y’imirimo ku
cyicaro cy Umuryango;
94 k) afata, abyumvikanyeho n’umuyobozi
w’ibiro bireba, ingamba zikenewe mu bijyanye
n’ubuyobozi n’imari kugira ngo hakorwe inama
n’izindi nama za buri rwego;
95 l) akora imirimo y’Ubunyamabanga ikorwa
mbere na nyuma y’inama z’Umuryango,
hitabwa ku nshingano za buri rwego;
96 m) ategura ibyifuzo by’inama ya mbere
n’abakuriye intumwa zivugwa muri nomero ya
49 y'Amategeko Rusange agenga Inama, Inteko
n'izindi nama z’Umuryango, hitabwa ku
byavuye mu bugishwanama ku rwego
rw’akarere; PP-06
97 n) afasha, aho bikenewe ku bufatanye na
guverinoma itumira, Ubunyamabanga
bw’inama z’Umuryango, kandi, bibaye
ngombwa, ku bufatanye n’umuyobozi bireba,
atanga serivisi n’ibikoresho bikenewe kugira
ngo inama z’Umuryango zikorwe, hitabazwa,
bigeze aho abona ko bikenewe, abakozi
b'Umuryango, hakurikijwe nomero 93 yavuzwe
haruguru. Umunyamabanga mukuru ashobora
kandi, abisabwe kandi ashingiye ku
masezerano, afasha Ubunyamabanga bw’izindi
nama zose zijyanye n'itumanaho ;
98 o) akora ibikenewe kugira ngo hatangazwe
ndetse hanatangwe, mu gihe gikwiye,
inyandiko za serivisi, amakuru y’ingenzi
n’izindi nyandiko n’amadosiye byateguwe
n’Ubunyamabanga bukuru n’inzego cyangwa
ibyamenyeshejwe Umuryango, cyangwa ibyo
inama n’Inama byasabye ko bitangazwa. Inama
ikomeza kugaragaza urutonde rw’inyandiko
zigomba gutangazwa, nyuma yo kubiganiraho
n’inama bireba ku bijyanye n’inyandiko za
serivisi n’izindi nyandiko inama zasabye ko
zitangazwa;
99 p) atangaza buri gihe, akoresheje amakuru
yakusanyijwe cyangwa yahawe, harimo ayo
ashobora gukura mu yindi miryango
mpuzamahanga, ikinyamakuru gitangaza
amakuru n’inyandiko rusange ku itumanaho;
100 q) nyuma yo kugisha inama komite
mpuzabikorwa na nyuma yo kwiga ku buryo
bwose bwo kuzigama, ategura kandi
agashyikiriza Inama umushinga w’ingengo
y’imari y’imyaka ibiri ikubiyemo amafaranga
akoreshwa n’Umuryango, hitabwa ku
mafaranga atagomba kurenga ayateganyijwe
n’inama y’ababifitiye ububasha. Uwo
mushinga w’ingengo y’imari ukubiyemo
amakuru ajyanye n’ingengo y’imari rusange
ishingiye ku byo Umuryango uzakoresha
n’ibyo uzavanamo, utegurwa hakurikijwe
amabwiriza agenga igengo y’imari atangwa
n’Umunyamabanga mukuru kandi ugizwe
n’inyandiko ebyiri. Inyadiko imwe ihuye
n’iyongera rya zeru ry’icyiciro cy’umusanzu,
iyindi ihuye n’iyongera riri munsi cyangwa
ringana n’amafaranga yose ntarengwa yagenwe
n’Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu byabo, nyuma yo gukoresha ayari
asigaye kuri konti igaragaza amafaranga
asigaye. Umwanzuro ujyanye n’ingengo
y’imari, nyuma yo kwemezwa n'Inama,
wohererezwa ibihugu bigize Umuryango mu
rwego rwo kubiha amakuru; PP-98 PP-06
101 r) abifashijwemo na Komite
mpuzabikorwa, akora raporo ku mikoreshereze
y’imari ya buri mwaka hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’amabwiriza agenga imari
akayishyikiriza Inama. Raporo ku
mikoreshereze y’imari na konti irategurwa
kandi igashyikirizwa Inama y’ababifitiye
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu byabo ikurikira
kugira ngo bisuzumwe kandi byemezwe
burundu;
102 s) abifashijwemo na Komite
mpuzabikorwa, akora raporo ngarukamwaka ku
bikorwa by’Umuryango, nyuma yo kwemezwa
n’Inama, igashyikirizwa ibihugu byose bigize
Umuryango; PP-98
102A s bis) akurikirana amasezerano
adasanzwe avugwa muri nomero 76A y'Itegeko
Shingiro, amafaranga akoreshwamo agomba
gutangwa n’abayashyizeho umukono mu buryo
bwemeranyijweho hagati yabo
n'Umunyamabanga mukuru. PP-98
103 t) akora indi mirimo yose
y’Ubunyamabanga bw’Umuryango;
104 u) akora indi mirimo iyo ari yo yose
ashinzwe n'Inama.
105-2 Umunyamabanga mukuru cyangwa
Umunyamabanga mukuru wungirije bashobora
kwitabira inama z’Umuryango mu rwego rwo
gutanga inama; Umunyamabanga mukuru
cyangwa umuhagarariye bashobora kwitabira
izindi nama zose z’Umuryango mu rwego rwo
gutanga inama. PP-06
CV / ingingo ya 6
AGACE KA 4

articles.heading: Komite mpuzabikorwa 106- 1 1) Komite mpuzabikorwa ifasha kandi ikagira inama Umunyamabanga mukuru ku
articles.text:
bibazo byose bivugwa mu biteganywa
n’ingingo ya 26 y’Itegeko Shingiro ndetse no
mu ngingo zijyanye z’aya Masezerano.
107- 2) Komite ishinzwe guhuza ibikorwa
n’imiryango yose mpuzamahanga ivugwa mu
ngingo ya 49 na 50 z’Itegeko Shingiro, ku
bijyanye n’abahagararira Umuryango mu nama
z’iyo miryango.
108- 3) Komisiyo isuzuma ibyavuye mu
bikorwa by’Umuryango kandi igafasha
Umunyamabanga mukuru mu gutegura raporo,
ivugwa muri nimero ya 86 y’aya Masezerano,
kugira ngo ishyikirizwe Inama.
109- 2 Komite igerageza gufatira hamwe
imyanzuro. Iyo umwanzuro udashyigikiwe na
benshi mu bagize komite, perezida wayo
ashobora, mu bihe bidasanzwe, gufata
ibyemezo nk’inshingano ye, iyo abona ko
gukemura ikibazo gihari byihutirwa kandi
bidashobora gutegereza ko inteko itaha iterana.
Muri ibyo bihe, amenyesha ibyo bibazo
bidatinze kandi mu nyandiko abagize Inama,
yerekana impamvu zatumye afata ibyo
byemezo, kandi abagezaho ibitekerezo, mu
nyandiko, byatanzwe n’abandi bagize komite.
Iyo ibibazo bisuzumwa mu bihe nk' ibyo
bitihutirwa ariko na none ari ngombwa,
bigomba gushyikirizwa Inama ikurikira
yongeye guterana kugira ngo ibisuzume. PP-98
110- 3 Perezida atumiza Komite byibura rimwe
mu kwezi; Komite ishobora kandi guterana iyo
bibaye ngombwa, bisabwe na babiri mu
bayigize.
111- 4 Raporo ku mirimo ya Komite
mpuzabikorwa irakorwa kandi igashyikirizwa
ibihugu bigize Umuryango. PP-02 PP-06
CV / Ingingo ya 7
AGACE KA 5: URWEGO
RW’ITUMANAHO RIKORESHA
INSAKAZAMAJWI

articles.heading: Inama y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi ku isi 112- 1 Hakurikijwe nimero 90 y'Itegeko Shingiro, inama y’itumanaho rikoresha
articles.text:
insakazamajwi iraterana kugira ngo isuzume
ibibazo byihariye by’itumanaho rikoreha
insakazamajwi. Inama z’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi yiga ku bintu biri ku murongo
w’ibyigwa wemejwe hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’iyi ngingo.
113- 2 1) Umurongo w’ibyingwa w’inama
y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi ku isi
ushobora kuba ukubiyemo:
114 a) gusubiramo amwe mu mabwiriza agenga
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi avugwa
mu ngingo ya 4 y'Itegeko Shingiro cyangwa,
mu buryo budasanzwe, kuyasubiramo yose;
115 b) ikindi kibazo icyo ari cyo cyose ku
rwego rw’isi kiri mu bushobozi bw’inama;
116 c) ikijyanye n'amabwiriza ahabwa komite
ishinzwe amabwiriza agenga itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi n’ibiro by’itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi ku bijyanye
n’ibikorwa byabyo n’isuzumwa ry’ibyo
bikorwa;
117 d) kugena imirongo migari igomba kwigwa
n’inteko y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
n’amatsinda ashinzwe ubushakshatsi ku
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi, hamwe
n’ibibazo bisuzumwa n’iyo nteko bijyanye
n’inama z’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
zizabaho mu gihe kizaza. PP-98
CV / Ingingo ya 7
118- 2) Gahunda y’ibyigwa muri rusange
igomba kugenwa kuva ku myaka ine kugeza
kuri itandatu mbere kandi gahunda y’ibyigwa
idasubirwaho ikagenwa n’Inama bibaye byiza
imyaka ibiri mbere y’inama, byumvikanyweho
n’ibihugu byinshi mu bigize Umuryango,
hashingiwe ku biteganywa na nimero 47 y'aya
Masezerano. Izo nyandiko ebyiri zo ku
murongo y’ibyigwa ziba zishingiye ku byifuzo
by’inama y’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi ku isi, hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
muri nomero 126 y’aya Masezerano. PP-94
PP-98
119- 3) Uwo murongo w’ibyigwa uba
ukubiyemo ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose
cyashyizwemo byemejwe n'Inama
y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
byabo.
120- 3 1) Uwo murongo w’ibyigwa ushobora
guhinduka:
121 a) bisabwe nibura na kimwe cya kane
cy’ibihugu bigize Umuryango. Ubwo busabe
bukorwa na buri gihugu kikabimenyesha
Umunyamabanga mukuru na we
akabishyikiriza Inama kugira ngo ibyemeze,
cyangwa PP-98
122 b) ku cyifuzo cy'Inama.
123- 2) Ibyasabiwe guhindurwa ku murongo
w’ibyigwa w’inama y’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi ku isi ntibishobora kwemezwa
burundu keretse byumvikanweho n’ibihugu
byinshi mu bigize Umuryango, hashingiwe ku
biteganywa na nomero 47 y’aya Masezerano.
PP-98
124- 4 Byongeye, inama:
125- 1) isuzuma ndetse ikanemeza raporo
y'Umuyobozi w’ibiro ku bikorwa by'Urwego
kuva mu nama iheruka;
126- 2) igeza ibyifuzo ku Nama ku bijyanye
n’ibyashyirwa ku murongo w’ibyigwa w’inama
izaba, igaragaza ibitekerezo byayo ku murongo
w’ibyigwa w’inama mu gihe cy'imyaka nibura
ine kandi igasuzuma ingaruka byatera mu
mikoreshereze y’amafaranga ;
127- 3) mu myanzuro yayo ishyiramo
amabwiriza cyangwa ibyifuzo, nkuko bikwiye,
bigomba kubahirizwa n’Umunyamabanga
mukuru n’inzego z’Umuryango.
CV / Ingingo ya 8
128- 5 Perezida na Visi-Perezida b'inteko
y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi,
ab’itsinda cyangwa amatsinda ashinzwe
ubushakashatsi bijyanye bashobora kwitabira
inama y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
ku isi bihuye.

articles.heading: Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu bigize Umuryango 47- 1 Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
articles.text:
bahagarariye ibihugu igizwe n’intumwa
zihagarariye ibihugu bigize Umuryango.
Itumizwa buri myaka ine. PP-98
48- 2 Hashingiwe ku byifuzo byatanzwe
n’ibihugu bigize Umuryango no kuri raporo
z’Inama, Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu bigize Umuryango: PP98
49- a) igena amahame rusange atuma intego
z’Umuryango zigerwaho nk’uko bivugwa mu
ngingo ya 1 y’iri Tegeko Shingiro;
CS / Ingingo ya 8
50 b) isuzuma raporo z'Inama ku bikorwa
by'Umuryango uhereye igihe Inama
y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
bigize Umuryango iheruka yateraniye ndetse no
kuri politiki rusange n'igenamigambi
by'Umuryango ; PP-94 PP-98
51 c) hashingiwe ku byemezo byafashwe
kubera raporo zivugwa muri nomero 50
yavuzwe haruguru, ishyiraho igenamigambi
ry’Umuryango kimwe n’ishingiro ry’ingengo
y’imari y’Umuryango ndetse ikanagena
amafaranga ntarengwa azakoreshwa muri icyo
gihe kugeza igihe Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu bigize Umuryango
ikurikira izabera, nyuma yo gusuzuma ibintu
byose bijyanye n’igikorwa cy’Umuryango muri
icyo gihe; PP-98 PP-02
51A c bis) ishyiraho, hashyirwa mu bikorwa
ibivugwa muri nomero ya 161D kugeza kuri
161G y'iri Tegeko Shingiro, inkunga yose
itangwa mu gihe cyo kugeza igihe inama
y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
bigize Umuryango ikurikira izabera,
hashingiwe ku byiciro by’imisanzu izatangwa
n’ibihugu bigize Umuryango. PP-98
52 d) itanga amabwiriza rusange ayo ari yo yose
agenga abakozi b’Umuryango ndetse
ikanagena, igihe ari ngombwa, umushahara
fatizo, ingano y’imishahara na gahunda igenga
indamunite na pansiyo ku bakozi bose
b’Umuryango;
53 e) isuzuma amakonti y’Umuryango ndetse
ikanayemeza, iyo hari akeneye kwemezwa;
54 f) itora Ibihugu bigize Umuryango
bihamagarirwa kuba mu Nama; PP-98
55 g) itora Umunyamabanga Mukuru,
Umunyamabanga Mukuru wungirije hamwe
n’abayobozi b’Ibiro by’inzego zigize
Umuryango bagomba gutorwa nk’abakozi
b’Umuryango;
56 h) itora abagize Komite ishinzwe kugenzura
itangazamakuru rikoresha insakazamajwi;
57 i) isuzuma ndetse ikanemeza, aho bicyenewe
kwemezwa, ibyifuzo bijyanye no kuvugurura
iri Tegeko Shingiro n’Amasezerano, byatanzwe
n’ibihugu bigize Umuryango, hubahirizwa
ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya 55 y’iri Tegeko
Shingiro n’ibiteganywa ku bijyanye
n’ivugururwa ry’Amasezerano; PP-94 PP-98
CS / Ingingo ya 9
58 j) yemeza cyangwa igasubiramo, igihe ari
ngombwa, Amasezerano hagati y’Umuryango
n’indi miryango mpuzamahanga, isuzuma
Amasezerano y’agateganyo n’iyo miryango
mpuzamahanga yemejwe n’Inama mu izina
ry’Umuryango kandi igafata umwanzuro
ukwiye kuri ayo Masezerano bitewe n’uko
bikwiye;
58A j bis) yemeza ndetse ikanavugurura
amategeko rusange agenga Inama, inteko
n’inama z’Umuryango; PP-98 PP-02
59 k) ikemura ibibazo byose by’itumanaho
ibona ko ari ngombwa.
59A 3 Mu buryo bwihariye, mu gihe kiri hagati
y’inama ebyiri zisanzwe z’ababifitiye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu bigize Umuryango, inama
idasanzwe y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu bigize Umuryango ishobora
gutumizwa gusa igihe kuri gahunda hari
ugukemura ibibazo byihariye: PP-94
59B a) bitewe n’icyemezo cy' inama isanzwe
y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
bigize Umuryango iheruka; PP-94
59C b) bisabwe Umunyamabanga mukuru na
bibiri bya gatatu by'ibihugu bigize Umuryango;
PP-94 PP-98
59D c) biturutse ku cyifuzo cyatanzwe n'Inama,
byemejwe byibura na bibiri bya gatatu
by'ibihugu bigize Umuryango. PP-94 PP-98

articles.heading: Amahame ajyanye n'amatora n'ibibazo bifitanye isano na yo 60 -1 Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
articles.text:
bahagarariye ibihugu bigize Umuryango, mu
gihe icyo ari cyo cyose cy’amatora avugwa
muri nimero ya 54 kugeza kuri 56 y’iri Tegeko
Shingiro , ikora ku buryo:
61 a) Ibihugu bigize Inama bitorwa hitawe ku
igabana ringana ry’imyanya ikenewe mu
Nama, mu turere twose tw’isi; PP-02
CS / Ingingo ya 10
62 b) Umunyamabanga mukuru,
Umunyamabanga mukuru wungirije hamwe
n’abayobozi b’inzego batorwa mu bakandida
batanzwe n’ibihugu bigize Umuryango
nk’abenegihugu babyo, kandi bose bagomba
kuba ari abenegihugu b’ibihugu bitandukanye
bigize Umuryango kandi, mu gihe cy’amatora,
hashingirwa ku ikwirakwizwa ry’imyanya
ringana mu turere tw’isi; kandi na none
amahame avugwa muri nimero ya 154 y'iri
Tegeko Shingiro akwiye kwitabwaho; PP-94
PP-98 PP-02
63 c) abagize Komite ishinzwe kugenzura
itangazamakuru rikoresha insakazamajwi
batorwa ku giti cyabo kandi bagatorwa mu
bakandida batanzwe n’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango nk’abenegihugu babyo. Buri
gihugu kigize Umuryango cyemerewe gutanga
umukandida umwe gusa. Abagize Komite
ishinzwe kugenzura itangazamakuru rikoresha
insakazamajwi ntibashobora kuba abenegihugu
b’igihugu kimwe n’icy’umuyobozi w’urwego
rushinzwe itangazamakuru rikoresha
insakazamajwi ; kugira ngo batorwe, ihame ryo
gukwirakwiza imyanya mu buryo bungana mu
turere tw’ isi ndetse n’amahame avugwa muri
nimero ya 93 y’ iri Tegeko Shingiro, akwiye
kwitabwaho. PP-94 PP-98 PP-02
64- 2 Ingingo zijyanye no gutangira akazi,
imyanya y’akazi no kongera kwemerwa
biteganyijwe mu Masezerano. PP-02

articles.heading: Komite ishinzwe kugenzura itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi 139 (UP) PP-98 140- 2 Uretse imirimo ivugwa mu ngingo ya 14
articles.text:
y'Itegeko Shingiro, Komite : PP-02
1) gasuzuma raporo z'umuyobozi w’ibiro
by’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamjwi zijyanye
n’ubushakashatsi, bisabwe n'umwe cyangwa
benshi mu bayobozi babikeneye, bwakozwe ku
bibazo bijyanye n’ukwivanga kw’imirongo
kandi agatanga ibyifuzo bikenewe.
2) gasuzuma na none ubujurire bw’ibyemezo
byafashwe n’ibiro by’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi bitagishije inama ku bijyanye
n’itangwa ry’uburenganzira bwo gukoresha
imirongo ivugirwaho, bisabwe n’umwe
cyangwa benshi mu bayobozi babikeneye.
141- 3 Abagize komite bagomba kwitabira
inama z’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
mu rwego rwo gutanga inama. Icyo gihe,
ntibaba bemerewe kwitabira izo nama nk’abaje
mu rwego rwo guhagararira ibihugu byabo. PP02
CV / Ingingo ya 10
141A 3 bis Abagize Komite babiri
batoranyijwe na Komite ku rwego rwo gutanga
inama, bitabira inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
n'inteko z’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi.
Muri ibyo bihe, abagize komite babiri mu
bagize komite batoranyijwe na yo ntibemerewe
kwitabira izo nama n’inteko nk’abaje mu rwego
rwo guhagararira ibihugu byabo. PP-02
142- 4 Umuryango wishyura gusa amafaranga
y’ingendo, ayo kubaho n’ay’ubwishingizi
yakoreshejwe n’umwe mu bagize komite mu
gihe ari gukora inshingano muri serivisi z’
Umuryango.
14A 4 bis) abagize komite, iyo bari gukora
inshingano zabo muri serivisi z’Umuryango,
nk’uko bisobanurwa mu Itegeko Shingiro
n’Amasezerano, cyangwa iyo batumwe
n’Umuryango, bagira uburenganzira
n’ubudahangarwa mu kazi bingana
n’ibyemerewe umuyobozi w’Umuryango
watowe na buri gihugu kigize Umuryango
hashingiwe ku biteganywa n’amategeko
y’igihugu cyangwa andi mategeko akoreshwa
muri buri gihugu kigize Umuryango. Ubu
burenganzira n’ubudahangarwa byemerewe
abagize Komite mu nyungu z’Umuryango
kandi atari mu nyungu zabo bwite. Ugize
komite ashobora cyangwa agomba kuvanwaho
ubudahangarwa n’Umuryango mu gihe
bigaragara ko ubudahangarwa bwabangamira
imigendekere myiza y’ubutabera kandi ko
kuvanwaho ubudahangarwa bitabangamira
inyungu z’Umuryango. PP-02
143 - 5 Komite ikora mu buryo bukurikira :
144- 1) Abagize Komite bitoramo perezida na
visi-perezida, bakora inshingano zabo mu gihe
cy’umwaka umwe. Nyuma yaho, visi-perezida
asimbura perezida buri mwaka, hagatorwa visiperezida mushya. Mu gihe perezida na visiperezida badahari, abagize Komite, kubera iyo
mpamvu, bitoramo perezida w'agateganyo.
145- 2) Ubusanzwe abagize komite baterana
inshuro zitarenze enye mu mwaka, buri nama
ikamara iminsi itarenze itanu, ku cyicaro
cy’Umuryango muri rusange, aho inama
zigomba kwitabirwa nibura na bibiri bya gatatu
by’abagize komite. Abagize komite bakora
imirimo yabo hakoreshwa uburyo bugezweho
bw’itumanaho. Iyo abagize komite babona ko
ari ngombwa kandi bitewe n'ibibazo byo
kwigwaho, abagize komite bashobora guterana
inshuro nyinshi, kandi, mu buryo budasanzwe
bashobora guterana kugera ku byumweru
bibiri. PP-02
CV /Ingingo ya 11
146- 3) Komite yihatira gufatira ibyemezo
hamwe. Iyo itabigezeho, icyemezo gifatwa
nk'igifite agaciro iyo nibura bibiri bya gatatu
by'abagize komite bagitoye. Buri wese mu
bagize komite agira ijwi rimwe; gutora mu izina
ry’undi ntibyemewe.
147- 4) Komite ishobora gushyiraho ingingo
ziyigenga mu gihe ibona ko ari ngombwa,
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n'Itegeko Shingiro,
aya Masezerano n'amabwiriza agenga
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi. Izo
ngingo zitangazwa nka kimwe mu bigize
amategeko agenga imikorere ya Komite.

articles.heading: Komisiyo ishinzwe ubushahakatsi ku itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi 148- 1 Amatsinda ashinzwe ubushakashatsi ku
articles.text:
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
ashyirwaho n’inteko y’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi.
149- 2 1) Amatsinda ashinzwe ubushakashatsi
ku itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi yiga ku
bibazo byemejwe hakurikijwe inzira
yashyizweho n’inteko y’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi kandi agategura umushinga ku
byifuzo bigomba kwemezwa hakurikijwe inzira
ivugwa muri nimero 246A kugeza 247 y’aya
Masezerano. PP-98
149A 1 bis) Amatsinda ashinzwe
ubushakashatsi ku itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi yiga kandi ku mirongo migari
yatanzwe mu myanzuro n'ibyifuzo by’inama
z’itumananho rikoresha insakazamajwi ku isi.
Ibyavuye muri ubwo bushakashatsi bitangwa
mu byifuzo cyangwa muri raporo zakozwe
hakurikijwe nomero 156 ivugwa hepfo. PP-98
150- 2) hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri nomero
158 ivugwa hepfo, kwiga ku bibazo hamwe
n’imirongo migari byavuzwe haruguru,
kuzibanda ku: PP-98
151- a) ikoreshwa ry’imirongo ivugirwaho
n’insakazamajwi n’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi ku butaka hamwe n’itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi mu kirere, ndetse
n’ikoreshwa ry’aho ibyogajuru bigomba kuba
biri n’izindi nzira zabyo; PP-98
CV/ Ingingo ya 11
152 b) imiterere n'imikorere y’ibintu bifite aho
bihuriye n’insakazamajwi;
153 c) imikorere y’ikigo cy’itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi;
154 d) Uko itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
ryitwara mu bibazo by’ibyago n’ibibazo
by’umutekano.
155 3) Mu buryo rusange, ubwo bushakashatsi
ntibukorwa ku bibazo by’ubukungu, ariko mu
gihe bugizwe no kugereranya imyanzuro
myinshi mu bya tekiniki cyangwa imikorere,
ibijyanye n’ubukungu bishobora kwitabwaho.
PP-98
156- 3 amatsinda ashinzwe ubushakashatsi ku
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi yiga kandi
ku byakorwa mbere bijyanye n’ibibazo bya
tekiniki, by’imikorereshereze n’uburyo bwo
gukoramo, bigashyikirizwa inama
y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi ku isi no
mu karere ngo zibisuzume ndetse anategura
raporo kuri iyo ngingo hakurikijwe gahunda
y'akazi yemejwe kubera icyo kibazo n'inteko
y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi cyangwa
hakurikizwa amabwiriza yatanzwe n'Inama.
157- 4 Buri tsinda rishinzwe ubushakashatsi
ritegura raporo yerekana aho imirimo igeze,
ibyifuzo byemejwe hakurikijwe uburyo bwo
kugisha inama buteganyijwe muri nomero 149
yavuzwe haruguru kugira ngo bishyikirizwe
inteko y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
ndetse n’imishinga y’ibyifuzo mishya cyangwa
yavuguruwe bigomba gusuzumwa n’inteko.
158- 5 Hitawe ku biteganywa muri nimero ya
79 y'Itegeko Shingiro, urwego rw’itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi hamwe n'urwego
rushinzwe ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho bihora
bisuzuma imirimo ivugwa kuva muri nimero
151 kugeza kuri 154 yavuzwe haruguru no muri
nomero 193 y'aya Masezerano mu bijyanye
n’urwego rushinzwe ubuziranenge
bw’itumanaho, hagamijwe kumvikana ku
mpinduka zaba mu isaranganya ry’ibibazo
bigomba kwigwaho n’inzego zombi. Izo
nzengo zigomba gukorana bya hafi kandi
zigashyiraho uburyo bwatuma habaho iryo
vugurura no gusoza ayo masezerano mu gihe
cyagenwe kandi neza. Iyo ubwumvikane
butabashije kubaho, icyo kibazo gishobora
gushyikirizwa inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu byabo kugira ngo igifatire
umwanzuro, binyuze mu Nama.
CV/ ingingo ya 11A
159- 6 Mu gusohoza inshingano zayo,
amatsinda ashinzwe ubushakashatsi ku
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi yitondera
cyane ibyo bakoraho ubushakashatsi kandi
agategura ibyifuzo bijyanye no gushyiraho,
guteza imbere no kunoza itumanaho mu bihugu
bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere, ku rwego
rw’akarere ndetse no ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Akora imirimo yayo yita cyane ku miryango yo
mu gihugu no mu karere ndetse n’indi
miryango mpuzamahanga ikora itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi kandi agafatanya na
yo, hazirikanwa ibikenewe n’Umuryango
kugira ngo ukomeze kuguma ku isonga mu
bijyanye n’itumanaho.
160- 7 Ku bwo koroshya isuzumwa ry’ibikorwa
by’urwego rw’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi, hagomba gufatwa ingamba zo
gushimangira ubufatanye no kwihuza n’indi
miryango ikora itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi, hamwe n’urwego rushinzwe
ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho. Inteko
y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
ishyiraho inshingano zihariye, ibisabwa mu
kugira uruhare n’amategeko agenga ishyirwa
mu bikorwa by’izo ngamba. PP-98

articles.heading: Ibiro by’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi 161- 1 Umuyobozi w’ibiro by’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi ategura kandi agahuza
articles.text:
ibikorwa by’urwego rw’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi. Inshingano z’ibiro zunganirwa
n’imirimo ivugwa mu biteganywa
n'amabwiriza agenga itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi.
162 - 2 Umuyobozi mukuru agomba
by'umwihariko,
163- 1) mu nama z’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi:
164 a) ahuza imirimo ikorwa mbere
y’amatsinda ashinzwe ubushakashatsi hamwe
n’andi matsinda ndetse n’ibiro, amenyesha
ibihugu bigize Umuryango n’abagize inzego
ibyavuye muri ibyo bikorwa, akusanya
ibitekerezo byabo kandi agatanga raporo
y’incamake mu nama, ishobora kuba
ikubiyemo ibyifuzo ku bijyanye n’amabwiriza.
PP-98 PP-02
165 b) Mu burenganzira bwe yitabira, ariko mu
rwego rwo gutanga inama, mu gihe cyo
kwigana ubushishozi ikibazo no kugifatira
umwanzuru mu inama y’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi, mu inteko z’itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi no mu matsinda
ashinzwe ubushakashatsi ku itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi hamwe no mu yandi
matsinda. Umuyobozi afata ingamba zose
zikenewe kugira ngo ategure inama
y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi n’izindi
nama z’inzego z’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi, agisha inama Ubunyamabanga
bukuru akurikije ibiteganywa muri nimero 94
y’aya Masezerano kandi, bibaye ngombwa,
agisha inama izindi nzego z’Umuryango, kandi
yita cyane ku mabwiriza yatanzwe n’Inama
ajyanye n’iyo myiteguro ; PP-02
166 c) atanga ubufasha ku bihugu bikiri mu
nzira y'amajyambere mu mirimo itegura inama
z’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi;
167- 2) ku birebana na komite ishinzwe
kugenzura itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi :
168 a) ategura imishinga y'amategeko agenga
imikorere akayishyikiriza komite ishinzwe
kugenzura itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
kugira ngo iyemeze ; iyo mishanga iba
ikubiyemo, cyane cyane, uburyo bwo kubara
hamwe n’amakuru akenewe kugira ngo
hakurikizwe ibiteganywa n’amabwiriza agenga
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi;
169 b) akwirakwiza mu bihugu byose bigize
Umuryango amategeko agenga imikorere ya
Komite, akusanya ibitekerezo byatanzweho
n'ubuyobozi hanyuma akabishyikiriza Komite;
PP-98 PP-02
170 c) atunganya amakuru yatanzwe
n’ubuyobozi hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’amabwiriza agenga itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi n’amasezerano yo mu karere
hamwe n’amategeko agenga imikorere bijyana
kandi akayategura, aho bishoboka, kugira ngo
atangazwe mu buryo bukwiye; PP-02
171 d) akurikiza amategeko agenga imikorere
yemejwe na Komite, ategura kandi agatangaza
imyanzuro ashingiye kuri ayo mategeko, kandi
agashyikiriza Komite umwanzuro wose
wasuzumwe wasabwe n'ubuyobozi ndetse
n’udashobora gukorwa hakurikijwe ayo
mategeko agenga imikorere;
172 e) hakurikijwe ingingo zijyanye
n’amabwiriza agenga itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi, yandika kandi akandikisha
nk’uko bigomba itangwa ry’uburenganzira bwo
gukoresha imirongo ivugirwaho kandi aho
bibaye ngombwa, n’ibijyana n’ibifite aho
bihuriye n’inzira z’ibyogajuru hamwe no
kujyanisha n’igihe n’ububikoshingiro
bw’Umuryango ku byogajuru n’imirongo yo
kuvugiraho ikoreshwa ku butaka; asubiramo
ibyanditswe bikubiye muri ubwo
bubikoshingiro, hagamijwe guhindura cyangwa
gukuramo, nk’uko bisabwa, amakuru yanditse
atagaragaza imikoreshereze nyayo y’umurongo
ukoreshwa n’insakazamajwi, byumvikanweho
n’ubuyobozi bireba;
173 f) afasha ubuyobozi bubishaka,
bwabyisabiye gukemura ibibazo bijyanye
n’ukwivanga kw’imirongo kandi bibaye
ngombwa, akabikoraho ubushakashatsi kandi
agakora raporo agashyiramo imishinga
y’ibyifuzo ku buyobozi bireba kugira ngo
bisuzumwe n’Akanama;
174 g) akora nk’umunyamabanga
nshingwabikorwa wa Komite;
175- 3) ahuza ibikorwa by’amatsinda ashinzwe
ubushakashatsi ku itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi n’andi matsinda kandi ashinzwe
gutegura ibyo bikorwa; PP-02
175A 3 bis) atanga ubufasha bukenewe mu
itsinda ngishwanama ku itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi kandi buri mwaka agaha
ibihugu bigize Umuryango n’abagize inzego
z’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi hamwe
n’Inama icyegeranyo ku byavuye mu bikorwa
by’itsinda ngishwanama; PP-98
175B 3 ter) afata ingamba zifatika kugira ngo
ibihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere
byoroherezwe kugira uruhare mu bikorwa
by’amatsinda ashinzwe ubushakashatsi ku
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi n’andi
matsinda. PP-98 PP-02
176- 4) kandi na none, akora ibi bikurikira:
177 a) ubushakashatsi kugira ngo atange inama
ku buryo hakoreshwa imiyoboro myinshi
ishoboka ivugirwaho n’insakazamajwi mu
turere turimo imirongo ivugirwaho dushobora
kubamo ukwivanga kw’imirongo, ndetse no ku
buryo hakoreshwa mu buryo bungana, bwiza,
kandi budasesagura aho ibyogajuru bigomba
kuba biri n’izindi nzira zabyo, hitawe ku
bikenewe n’ibihugu bigize Umuryango
bikeneye ubufasha, ibikenewe ku buryo
bwihariye n’ibihugu bikiri mu nzira
y'amajyambere, hamwe n’imiterere yihariye
y’ibihugu bimwe na bimwe; PP-98
178 b) ahanahana n’ibihugu bigize Umuryango
n’abagize inzego amakuru ashobora
gukoreshwa hakoreshejwe imashini cyangwa
ubundi buryo, akora kandi akajyanisha n’igihe
inyandiko n’ububikoshingiro bw’amakuru
by’inzego z’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi, kandi agafata ingamba zikwiye
hamwe n’Umunyamabanga mukuru, bibaye
ngombwa, kugira ngo bitangazwe mu ndimi
zikoreshwa n’Umuryango hakurikijwe nimero
172 y'Itegeko Shingiro; PP-98 PP-06
179 c) abika izo nyandiko za ngombwa nk’uko
bigomba;
180 d) atanga, muri raporo ishyikirizwa inama
y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi ku isi,
incamake y'ibikorwa by'urwego kuva inama
iheruka yaba ; iyo nta nama y’itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi ku isi iteganyijwe,
raporo ku bikorwa by’Urwego mu gihe
gikurikira inama iheruka ishyikirizwa Inama,
kandi mu rwego rwo gutanga amakuru,
igashyikirizwa ibihugu bigize Umuryango
ndetse n'abagize Urwego; PP-98 PP-02
181 e) ategura ingengo y’imari igaragaza
ibizakenerwa ashingiye ku kiguzi gihuye
n’ibikenewe n’urwego rw’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi kandi akayishyikiriza
Umunyamabanga mukuru, kugira ngo
isuzumwe na Komite mpuzabikorwa kandi
ishyirwe mu ngengo y’imari y’Umuryango.
181A f) buri mwaka, ashyiraho gahunda
y’ibikorwa iri mu myaka ine ifata umwaka
ukurikira n'imyaka itatu nyuma yaho, harimo
n’ingaruka zaturuka mu mikoreshereze
y’amafaranga mu bizakorwa n’ibiro mu rwego
rwo gufasha urwego rwose hamwe; iyo
gahunda y’ibikorwa y’imyaka ine izasuzumwa
n’itsinda ngishwanama ku itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi hakurikijwe ingingo ya 11A
y’aya Masezerano kandi isuzumwa ndetse
ikanemezwa n’Inama buri mwaka; PP-98 PP02
CV / Ingingo ya 13
182- 3 Umuyobozi ahitamo abakozi mu bya
tekiniki n’ubuyobozi bw’Urwego nk’uko
byateganyijwe mu ngengo y’imari yemejwe
n’Inama. Ishyirwaho ry'abo bakozi mu bya
tekiniki n'ubuyobozi rigenwa
n'Umunyamabanga mukuru, abyumvikanyeho
n'Umuyobozi. Icyemezo cya nyuma cyo
gushyiramo cyangwa kwirukana umukozi
gifatwa n’Umunyamabanga mukuru.
183- 4 Umuyobozi agomba gutanga ubufasha
bwa tekiniki bukenewe mu rwego rushinzwe
guteza imbere itumanaho mu rwego rwo
kubahiriza ibiteganywa n’Itegeko Shingiro
n'aya Masezerano.
AGACE KA 6: URWEGO RUSHINZWE
UBUZIRANENGE BW’ITUMANAHO

articles.heading: Inama z’Urwego rw’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi n’inteko z’Urwego rw’itumanaho rikoresha
articles.text:
insakazamajwi
89- 1 Inama mpuzamahanga y’itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi ishobora gusubiramo
igice kimwe cyangwa mu buryo budasanzwe,
amabwiriza yose agenga itangazamakuru
rikoresha insakazamajjwi kandi ishobora no
gukemura ikindi kibazo icyo ari cyo cyose, kiri
ku rwego rw’isi yose, kiri mu bushobozi bwayo
kandi kiri mu bigomba kwigwaho. Indi mirimo
y’iyo Nama ivugwa mu Masezerano.
90- 2 Inama mpuzamahanga z’itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi ubusanzwe ziterana
buri myaka itatu cyangwa ine; ariko, ukurikije
ibiteganyijwe mu Masezerano, inama nk'iyi
ishobora kudaterana cyangwa inama
y'inyongera ishobora guterana. PP-98 PP-06
91- 3 inteko z’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi na zo ubusanzwe ziterana buri
myaka itatu cyangwa ine kandi zishobora
guhurizwa ahantu hamwe ndetse n’igihe kimwe
n’inama mpuzamahanga y’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi mu rwego rwo kunoza
imikorere n’umusaruro w’Urwego
rw’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi. Inteko
z’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
zishyiraho, mu bya tekiniki, ibyo Inama
y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
zizashingiraho mu mirimo yazo kandi zikagira
icyo zikora ku byifuzo byose byatanzwe
n’inama zavuzwe; ibyo zikora bivugwa mu
Masezerano. PP-98 PP-06
CS / Ingingo ya 14
92- 4 Ibyemezo by’inama mpuzamahanga
z’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi, inteko
z’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi hamwe
n’inama z’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
mu karere, igihe cyose, bigomba kuba
bikurikiza ibiteganywa n’iri Tegeko Shingiro
n’Amasezerano. Ibyemezo by’inteko
z’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi cyangwa
inama z’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
mu karere na byo, igihe cyose, bigomba
gukurikiza ibitegnywa n’amabwiriza agenga
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi. Mu gihe
cyo gufata imyanzuro cyangwa ibyemezo,
inama zigomba kuzirikana ingaruka zishobora
guterwa n’imikoreshereze y’amafaranga kandi
zikirinda gufata imyanzuro cyangwa ibyemezo
bishobora gutuma amafaranga yateganyijwe
n’inama y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu bigize Umuryango arenga. PP-98

articles.heading: Komite ishinzwe kugenzura itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi 93- 1 Komite ishinzwe kugenzura itumanaho
articles.text:
rikoresha insakazamajwi kagizwe
n’abanyamuryango batowe kandi bafite
ubumenyi mu bijyanye n’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi kandi bafite uburambe mu
kugenera no gukoresha imirongo
insakazamajwi ivugiraho. Buri
munyamuryango agomba kumenya imiterere
y’akarere, ubukungu n’imiturire mu karere
runaka k’isi. Abanyamuryango bakorera
Umuryango mu buryo bwigenga kandi rimwe
na rimwe.
93A 1 bis) Komite ishinzwe kugenzura
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi igizwe
n’abanyamuryango batarenze 12 cyangwa
bangana na 6% by’umubare w’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango, bitewe n’umubare waba ari
munini. PP-98
94 - 2 inshingano za Komite ishinzwe
kugenzura itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi
zigizwe:
CS / Ingingo ya 14
95 a) kwemeza amategeko y’imikorere,
akubiyemo ibijyanye na tekiniki, hakurikijwe
amabwiriza agenga itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi n’ibyemezo by’inama
y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi zibifitiye
ububasha. Ayo mategeko y’imikorere
akoreshwa n’ubuyobozi na Biro mu gukurikiza
amabwiriza agenga itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi kugira ngo handikwe ibyemezo
bitanga uburenganzira bwo gukoresha
umurongo uvugiraho insakazamajwi
byatanzwe n’ibihugu bigize Umuryango. Aya
mategeko ategurwa mu buryo buboneye kandi
ashobora gutangwaho ibitekerezo n’ubuyobozi
kandi, mu gihe habaye ukutumvikana, ikibazo
gishyikirizwa inama y’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi itaha; PP-98 PP-02
96 b) gusuzuma ikindi kibazo icyo ari cyo cyose
kidashobora gukemuka hakurikijwe amategeko
agenga imikorere yavuzwe haruguru;
97 c) gukora imirimo yose y’inyongera ijyanye
no kugenera no gukoresha imirongo ivugiraho
insakazamajwi, nk’uko bigaragara muri nimero
ya 78 y’iri Tegeko Shingiro, hakurikijwe
uburyo buteganywa n’amabwiriza agenga
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi,
bwashyizweho n’inama ibifitiye ububasha
cyangwa n'Inama ihagarariye inama
y’ababifitiye ububasha ku bwumvikane bwa
benshi mu bihugu bigize Umuryango mu rwego
rwo gutegura inama nk’iyo cyangwa gushyira
mu bikorwa ibyemezo byayo. PP-98
98- 3 1) Abagize Komite ishinzwe kugenzura
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi, mu
gusohoza inshingano zabo muri iyo Komite,
ntibakora nk’abahagarariye ibihugu byabo
cyangwa uturere, ahubwo nk’abari mu
Shingirono mpuzamahanga. By'umwihariko,
buri wese mu bagize Komite agomba kwirinda
kugira uruhare mu byemezo bireba ubuyobozi
bwe.
99- 2) Nta muntu n’umwe mu bagize Komite
ushobora, ku bijyanye no gukora akazi ukorera
Umuryango, ugomba gusaba cyangwa
guhabwa amabwiriza na guverinoma iyo ari yo
yose, cyangwa uwo ari we wese uba muri
guverinoma iyo ari yo yose, cyangwa
umuryango uwo ari wo wose wa Leta cyangwa
wigenga cyangwa umuntu ukorera Leta
cyangwa ukora ku giti cye. Abagize Komite
bagomba kwirinda gufata icyemezo icyo ari cyo
cyose cyangwa kugira uruhare mu cyemezo
icyo ari cyo cyose gishobora kudahuza na sitati
yabo nk' uko bisobanurwa muri nimero 98
yavuzwe haruguru. PP-98
CS / Ingingo ya 15
100-3) Ibihugu bigize Umuryango n’ inzego
bigomba z’itumanaho zigomba kubahiriza
imiterere mpuzamahanga y’imikorere
y’abagize Komite kandi bakirinda kugira
uruhare mu mirimo abagize Komite bashinzwe.
PP-98
101- 4 Uburyo Komite ishinzwe kugenzura
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi ikoramo
busobanurwa mu Masezerano.

articles.heading: Ibiro bishinzwe ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho 198- 1 Umuyobozi w'ibiro bishinzwe ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho ategura kandi
articles.text:
agahuza ibikorwa by’urwego rushinzwe
ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho.
199- 2 Umuyobozi by'umwihariko:
200 a) ajyanisha n’igihe buri mwaka,
abyumvikanyeho n'abaperezida b'amatsinda
ashinzwe ubushakashatsi ku buziranenge
bw’itumanaho n'andi matsinda, gahunda
y'akazi yemejwe n'inteko ishinzwe
ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho ku isi; PP-98 PP02
201 b) kwitabira, nk’uburenganzira, ariko mu
rwego rwo gutanga inama, mu gihe cyo
kwigana ubushishozi ikibazo no kugifatira
umwanzuru mu nteko zishinzwe ubuziranenge
bw’itumanaho ku isi, mu matsinda ashinzwe
ubushakashatsi ku buziranenge bw’itumanaho
hamwe no mu yandi matsinda. Umuyobozi
afata ingamba zose zikenewe kugira ngo
ategure inteko n’izindi nama z’inzego
zishinzwe ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho, agisha
inama ubunyamabanga bukuru akurikije
ibiteganywa muri nimero 94 y’aya masezerano
kandi, bibaye ngombwa, agisha inama izindi
nzego z’umuryango, kandi yita cyane ku
mabwiriza yatanzwe n’Inama ajyanye no
gutegura iyo nama; PP-98 PP-02
202 c) atunganya amakuru yatanzwe
n’ubuyobozi hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’amabwiriza agenga itumanaho
mpuzamahanga cyangwa ibyemezo by’inteko
ishinzwe ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho ku isi
kandi akayategura, aho bishoboka, kugira ngo
atangazwe mu buryo bukwiye; PP-98
CV / ingingo ya 15
203 d) ahanahana n’ibihugu bigize umuryango
n’abagize inzego amakuru ashobora
gukoreshwa hakoreshejwe imashini cyangwa
ubundi buryo, akora kandi akajyanisha n’igihe
inyandiko n’ububikoshingiro bw’amakuru
by’inzego zishinzwe ubuziranenge
bw’itumanaho kandi agafata ingamba zikwiye
hamwe n’umunyamabanga mukuru, bibaye
ngombwa, kugira ngo bitangazwe mu ndimi
zikoreshwa n’umuryango hakurikijwe nimero
172 y'Itegeko Shingiro; PP-98 PP-06
204 e) atanga, muri raporo ishyikirizwa inteko
ishinzwe ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho ku isi,
incamake y'ibikorwa by'urwego kuva inteko
iheruka yaba kandi agashyikiriza Inama hamwe
n’ibihugu bigize umuryango ndetse n’abagize
urwego raporo ku bikorwa by’uru urwego mu
gihe cy’imyaka ibiri ikurikira inteko iheruka,
keretse inteko ya kabiri yatumijwe; PP-98
205 f) ategura ingengo y’imari igaragaza
ibizakenerwa ashingiye ku kiguzi gihuye
n’ibikenewe n’urwego rushinzwe ubuziranenge
bw’itumanaho kandi akayishyikiriza
Umunyamabanga mukuru, kugira ngo
isuzumwe na Komite mpuzabikorwa kandi
ishyirwe mu ngengo y’imari y’Umuryango.
205A g) buri mwaka, ashyiraho gahunda
y’ibikorwa iri mu myaka ine ifata umwaka
utaha n'imyaka itatu ikurikira, harimo
n’ingaruka zaturuka mu mikoreshereze
y’amafaranga mu bikorwa n’ibiro mu rwego
rwo gufasha urwego rwose hamwe ; iyo
gahunda y’ibikorwa y’imyaka ine isuzumwa
n’itsinda ngishwanama ku buziranenge
bw’itumanaho hakurikijwe ingingo ya 14A
y’aya masezerano kandi isuzumwa ndetse
ikanemezwa n’Inama buri mwaka; PP-98 PP02
205B h) atanga ubufasha bukenewe mu itsinda
ngishwanama ku buziranenge bw’itumanaho
kandi buri mwaka agaha ibihugu bigize
Umuryango n’abagize inzego zishinzwe
ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho hamwe n’Inama
icyegeranyo ku byavuye mu bikorwa by’itsinda
ngishwanama ; PP-98
205C i) atanga ubufasha mu bihugu bikiri mu
nzira y'amajyambere mu mirimo yo gutegura
inteko ishinzwe ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho
ku isi, cyane cyane mu rwego rwo kwiga ku
bibazo byihutirwa muri ibyo bihugu. PP-98
CV/ Ingingo ya 16
206- 3 Umuyobozi ahitamo abakozi mu bya
tekiniki n’ubuyobozi bw’urwego rushinzwe
ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho nk’uko
byateganyijwe mu ngengo y’imari yemejwe
n’Inama. Ishyirwaho ry'abo bakozi mu bya
tekiniki n'ubuyobozi rigenwa
n'umunyamabanga mukuru, abyumvikanyeho
n'umuyobozi. Icyemezo cya nyuma cyo
gushyiraho cyangwa kwirukana umukozi
gifatwa n’ umunyamabanga mukuru.
207- 4 Umuyobozi agomba gutanga ubufasha
bwa tekiniki bukenewe mu rwego rushinzwe
guteza imbere itumanaho mu rwego rwo
kubahiriza ibiteganywa n’Itegeko Shingiro
n'aya masezerano.
IGICE CYA 7: URWEGO RUSHINZWE
ITERAMBERE RY’ITUMANAHO

articles.heading: Inama nkuru ishinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho 207A 1 Inama nkuru ishinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho ku isi ifite ububasha bwo
articles.text:
kwemeza uburyo bwo gukoreramo n’uburyo
bwa kubahirizwa mu micungire y’ibikorwa
by’urwego, hakurikijwe nomero 145A
y'Itegeko Shingiro. PP-02
208- 1 bis) Hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri
nimero 118 y'Itegeko Shingiro, inama nkuru
zishinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho zikora ibi
bikurikira:
209 a) inama nkuru zishinzwe iterambere
ry’itumanaho ku isi zishyiraho gahunda y’akazi
n’amabwiriza mu rwego rwo kugaragaza
ibibazo n’ibyihutirwa bijyanye n’iterambere
ry’itumanaho kandi zigatanga icyerekezo
cy’urwego rushinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho
muri gahunda yarwo y’akazi. Zemeza mu
rwego rwa gahunda y’akazi yavuzwe haruguru,
niba ari ngombwa kugumishaho, gusesa
amatsinda ashinzwe ubushakashatsi ariho
cyangwa gushyiraho andi mashya kandi
zikanaha buri tsinda ibibazo rigomba kwigaho ;
PP-06
CV / Ingingo ya 16
209A bis) yemeza niba ari ngombwa
kugumishaho, gusesa cyangwa gushyiraho andi
matsinda, ikanashyiraho ba perezida na ba visiperezida; PP-02
209B a ter) ishyiraho manda yerekeye
amatsinda avugwa muri nomero 209A yavuzwe
haruguru, adashobora kwakira ibibazo cyangwa
ibyifuzo. PP-02
210 b) inama nkuru zishinzwe iterambere
ry’itumanaho mu karere zisuzuma ibibazo
n’ibyihutirwa bijyanye n’iterambere
ry’itumanaho, hitawe kubikenewe n’imiterere
y’akarere bireba; zishobora kandi gutanga
ibyifuzo mu nama nkuru zishinzwe iterambere
ry’itumanaho ku isi ma nama; PP-02
211 c) inama nkuru zishinzwe iterambere
ry’itumanaho zigomba gushyiraho intego
n’ingamba bigamije iterambere ry’itumanaho
ku rwego rumwe ku isi ndetse no mu karere,
hitabwa cyane ku kwagura no kujyanisha
n’igihe imiyoboro na serivise z’ibihugu bikiri
mu nzira y'amajyambere ndetse no kongera
ibikoresho bishya bikenewe kugira ngo
bishoboke. Zikora nk’ihuriro mu rwego rwo
gusuzuma ibibazo bya politiki rusange,
imitunganyirize, imikorere, bijyanye
n’amabwiriza, bya tekiniki, by’amafaranga
n’ibindi bijyanye, harimo no gushakisha ahandi
hashya haturuka amafaranga yo gushyira mu
bikorwa no kubishyira mu bikorwa;
212 d) inama zishinzwe iterambere
ry’itumanaho ku isi no mu karere, mu
bushobozi bwazo, zisuzuma raporo
zashyikirijwe kandi zikanagenzura ibikorwa
by’inzego ; zishobora kandi gusuzuma ibibazo
bijyanye n’iterambere ry’itumanaho bifite aho
bihuriye n’ibikorwa by’izindi nzego
z’Umuryango.
213- 2 Umushinga wa gahunda y’ibyigwa mu
Nama zishinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho
utegurwa n’Umuyobozi w’ibiro bishinzwe
iterambere ry’itumanaho; igashyikirizwa
Umunyamabanga mukuru kugira ngo yemezwe
n’Inama ari uko yemeranyijweho n’ibihugu
byinshi mu bigize Umuryango mu gihe ari
iy’inama ku isi cyangwa yemeranyijweho
n’ibihugu byinshi mu bigize Umuryango byo
muri ako karere bireba mu gihe ari iy’ inama
mu karere, hashingiwe ku biteganywa na
nimero 47 y'aya Masezerano. PP-98
CV / Ingingo ya 17
213A Inteko ishinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho
ishobora kohereza ibibazo byihariye mu itsinda
ngishwanama ku iterambere ry’itumanaho biri
mu bubasha bwaryo, hagaragazwa ingamba
zifuzwa kuri ibyo bibazo. PP-98 PP-02

articles.heading: Amatsinda ashinzwe inyigo ku iterambere ry’itumanaho 214- 1 Amatsinda ashinzwe ubushakashatsi ku
articles.text:
iterambere ry’itumanaho agomba kwiga
ibibazo by’itumanaho byihariye, harimo
ibibazo bivugwa muri nomero 211 haraguru
bireba ibihugu bikiri mu nzira y'amajyambere.
Ayo matsinda ashinzwe gukora inyigo aba ari
make kandi yarashyiriweho igihe gito, bitewe
n’umutungo uhari, aba afite ibyo yigaho
byihariye, ku bibazo ndetse n’ikibazo
kigaragaza inyungu z’ingenzi ku bihugu bikiri
mu nzira y'amajyambere kandi agahabwa
ibikorwa ngenderwaho.
215- 2 Hitawe ku biteganywa muri nimero 119
y'Itegeko Shingiro, Urwego rushinzwe
itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi, urwego
rushinzwe ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho hamwe
n’Urwego rushinzwe iteramnbere ry’itumanaho
bihora bisuzuma ibibazo byizweho, hagamijwe
kumvikana ku isaranganya ry’imirimo,
gushyira hamwe imbaraga no kunoza
imikoranire. Izo nzego zishyiraho uburyo
bwatuma habaho iryo vugururwa no gusoza ayo
Masezerano mu gihe cyagenwe kandi neza.
215A 3 Buri tsinda rishinzwe ubushakashatsi
ku iterambere ry’itumanaho ritegura raporo
ishyikirizwa inama ku isi ishinzwe iterambere
ry’itumanaho yerekana aho imirimo igeze
ndetse n’imishinga y’ibyifuzo mishya cyangwa
yavuguruwe kugira ngo bisuzumwe n’inama.
PP-98
215B 4 Amatsinda ashinzwe ubushakashatsi ku
iterambere ry’itumanaho yiga ku bibazo kandi
ikanakora imishinga y’ibyifuzo bigomba
kwemezwa hakurikijwe uburyo buvugwa muri
nimero 246A kugeza kuri 247 y’aya
Masezerano. PP-98
CV / Ingingo ya 17A
PP-98 Ingingo ya 17A:Itsinda Ngishwanama
ku iterambere ry’itumanaho
215C 1 Itsinda Ngishwanama ku Iterambere
ry’itumanaho rishobora kwitabirwa
n’abahagarariye ubuyobozi bw’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango ndetse n’abahagarariye abagize
urwego hamwe n’abaperezida n’abavisiperezida b’amatsinda ashinzwe ubushakashatsi
n’andi matsinda, kandi rigakora ribifashijwemo
n’Umuyobozi. PP-98 PP-02 PP-06
215D 2 Itsinda Ngishwanama ku iterambere
ry’itumanaho: PP-98
215E 1) risuzuma ibyihutirwa, gahunda,
ibikorwa, ibibazo by’amafaranga n’ingamba
zubahirizwa mu bikorwa by’urwego rushinzwe
iterambere ry’itumanaho; PP-98
215EA 1 bis) risuzuma ishyirwa mu bikorwa
rya gahunda y'ibikorwa y’igihe giheruka,
kugira ngo hamenyekane ibyo ibiro bitagezeho
cyangwa aho bitashoboye kugera ku ntego
ziteganyijwe muri iyo gahunda, kandi rikagira
inama Umuyobozi mu bijyanye n’ingamba
zikeneye gukosorwa; PP-02
215F 2) risuzuma intambwe imaze guterwa mu
ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya gahunda y'ibikorwa
yashyizweho hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri
nomero 209 y'aya Masezerano; PP-98
215G 3) ritanga imirongo ngenderwaho ijyanye
n’ibikorwa by’amatsinda ashinzwe
ubushakashatsi; PP-98
215H 4) rishyiraho ingamba zigamije cyane
cyane gushishikariza ubufatanye no guhuza
n’urwego rushinzwe itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi, urwego rushinzwe
ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho zibishoboye,
n’Ubunyamabanga bukuru hamwe n’ibindi
bigo bishinzwe iterambere n’imari.
PP-98
215I 5) rishyiraho uburyo bwaryo bwo
gukoreramo buhura n’uburyo bwemejwe
n’inama ishinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho ku
isi. PP-98
CV/ Ingingo ya 18
215J 6) ritegura raporo yo guha Umuyobozi
w’ibiro bishinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho
igaragaza ingamba zafashwe ku bijyanye
n’ibyavuzwe haruguru. PP-98
215JA 6 bis) ritegura raporo yo gushyikiriza
inama ishinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho ku isi
ku bibazo yashinzwe hakurikijwe nomero 213A
y'aya Masezerano kandi rikayishyikiriza
Umuyobozi kugira ngo ayishyikirize inama.
PP-02
215K 3 Abahagarariye ibigo bishinzwe
ubufatanye no gutanga imfashanyo mu
iterambere mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira
y’amajyambere n’ibigo mpuzamahanga bifasha
mu iterambere ry’ubukungu mu bihugu
bikennye bashobora gutumirwa n’umuyobozi
kugira ngo bitabire inama z’itsinda
ngishwanama.
PP-98

articles.heading: PP-98 Ibiro bishinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho 216- 1 Umuyobozi w' ibiro bishinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho ategura kandi agahuza
articles.text:
ibikorwa by’urwego rushinzwe iterambere
ry’itumanaho.
217- 2 Umuyobozi by’umwihariko agomba:
218 a) kugira uruhare mu burenganzira bwose,
ariko mu rwego rwo gutanga inama, mu gihe
cyo kwigana ubushishozi ikibazo no kugifatira
umwanzuro mu nama ishinzwe iterambere
ry’itumanaho ku isi no mu yandi matsinda.
Umuyobozi afata ingamba zose zikenewe
kugira ngo ategure inama n’izindi nama
z’urwego rushinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho,
agisha inama Ubunyamabanga bukuru
akurikije ibiteganywa muri nimero 94 y’aya
Masezerano kandi, bibaye ngombwa, agisha
inama izindi nzego z’Umuryango, kandi yita
cyane ku mabwiriza yatanzwe n’Inama ajyanye
no gutegura iyo nama; PP-02
219 b) atunganya amakuru yatanzwe
n’ubuyobozi hakurikijwe ibyemezo
n’imyanzuro bijyanye byafashwe n’Inama
y’ababfitiye ububasha n’inama ishinzwe
iterambere ry’itumanaho ku isi kandi
akayategura, aho bishoboka, kugira ngo
atangazwe mu buryo bukwiye;
CV/ Ingingo ya 18
220 c) ahanahana n’abagize ibiro amakuru
ashobora gukoreshwa hakoreshejwe imashini
cyangwa ubundi buryo, akora kandi
akajyanisha n’igihe inyandiko
n’ububikoshingiro bw’amakuru by’urwego
rushinzwe iteramber ry’itumanaho kandi
agafata ingamba zikwiye hamwe
n’Umunyamabanga mukuru, bibaye ngombwa,
kugira ngo bitangazwe mu ndimi zikoreshwa
n’Umuryango hakurikijwe nimero 172
y'Itegeko Shingiro; PP-06
221 d) akusanya kandi agategura mu rwego rwo
gutangaza, ku bufatanye n’Ubunyamabanga
bukuru n’izindi nzego z’ Umuryango amakuru
ajyanye na tekiniki n’ubuyobozi ashobora
gukenerwa n’ibihugu bikiri mu nzira
y’amajyambere kugira ngo abifashe gukora
neza imiyoboro y’itumanaho yabyo. Ibyo
bihugu n’ubundi ni byo bitekerezwaho
habonetse ubundi bushobozi buturutse muri
gahunda mpuzamahanga ziri mu nshingano
z’Umuryango w'Abibumbye;
222 e) atanga, muri raporo ishyikirizwa inama
ishinzwe iterambere ry’itumanaho ku isi,
incamake y'ibikorwa by'Urwego kuva inama
iheruka yaba kandi agashyikiriza Inama hamwe
n’ibihugu bigize umuryango ndetse n’abagize
urwego raporo ku bikorwa by’ uru rwego mu
gihe cy’imyaka ibiri ikurikira inama iheruka,
PP-98
223 f) ategura ingengo y’imari igaragaza
ibizakenerwa ashingiye ku kiguzi gihuye
n’ibikenewe n’urwego rushinzwe iterambere
ry’itumanaho kandi akayishyikiriza
Umunyamabanga mukuru, kugira ngo
isuzumwe na Komite mpuzabikorwa kandi
ishyirwe mu ngengo y’imari y’ Umuryango ;
PP-98
223A g) ategura buri mwaka, gahunda
y’ibikorwa iri mu myaka ine izafata umwaka
ukurikira n'imyaka itatu nyuma yaho, harimo
n’ingaruka zaturuka mu mikoreshereze
y’amafaranga mu bizakorwa n’ibiro mu rwego
rwo gufasha urwego rwose hamwe; iyo
gahunda y’ibikorwa y’imyaka ine isuzumwa
n’itsinda ngishwanama ku iterambere
ry’itumanaho hakurikijwe ingingo ya 17A
y’aya Masezerano kandi isuzumwa ndetse
ikanemezwa n’Inama buri mwaka; PP-98 PP02
223B h) atanga ubufasha bukenewe mu itsinda
ngishwanama ku iterambere ry’itumanaho
kandi buri mwaka agaha ibihugu bigize
Umuryango n’abagize inzego zishinzwe
ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho hamwe n’Inama
icyegeranyo ku byavuye mu bikorwa bye. PP98
224 - 3 Umuyobozi akora afatanyije n’abandi
bayobozi batowe kandi yihatira gushimangira
ubwiganze bw’uruhare rw’Umuryango mu
gutuma habaho iterambere ry’itumanaho; afata
ingamba zikenewe, ku bufatanya n’Umuyobozi
w’ibiro bireba, kugira ngo hakorwe ibikwiye,
urugero nko gutumiza inama zishinwe amakuru
ajyanye n’ibikorwa by’Urwego bireba. PP-98
225- 4 Bisabwe n’ibihugu bigize Umuryango
bireba, umuyobozi, abifashijwemo n’abayobozi
b’ibindi biro kandi, aho bibaye ngombwa,
n’Umunyamabanga mukuru, akora
ubushakashatsi kandi agatanga inama ku bibazo
bijyanye n’itumanaho ryo mu gihugu muri ibyo
bihugu bigize Umuryango. Mu gihe ubwo
bushakashatsi bugaragaza ibisubizo byinshi mu
bya tekiniki kandi bishoboka, ibijyanye
n’ubukungu bishobora kwibandwaho. PP-98
226- 5 Umuyobozi atoranya umukozi ushinzwe
tekiniki n’uw’ubuyobozi wa Biro ishinzwe
iterambere ry’itumanaho mu rwego rw’ingengo
y’imari yemejwe n’inama. Ishyirwaho ry'aba
bakozi rigenwa n'Umunyamabanga mukuru,
byumvikanweho n'Umuyobozi. Icyemezo
ndakuka cyo gushyiraho cyangwa kwirukanwa
kireba Umunyamabanga Mukuru.
227 (SUP) PP-98
IGICE CYA 8: INGINGO ZIHURIWEHO
N'IBYICIRO BITATU

articles.heading: Uruhare rw’ibigo n’imiryango itari iy’ubuyobozi mu bikorwa by’Umuryango 228 - 1 Umunyamabanga Mukuru n’abayobozi
articles.text:
ba Biro bashishikariza inzego n’imiryango
ikurikira kugira uruhare runini mu bikorwa
by’Umuryango:
229 a) ibigo byemewe, imiryango y’ubumenyi
n’inganda n’ibigo bishinzwe imari cyangwa
iterambere byemejwe n’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango bireba; PP-98
230 b) ibindi bigo bishinzwe ibibazo
by'itumanaho byemejwe n'ibihugu bigize
Umuryango bireba; PP-98
231 c) itumanaho ry’akarere n’irindi tumanaho
mpuzamahanga, ubuziranenge, imari cyangwa
imiryango y’iterambere.
232- 2 Abayobozi ba Biro bakorana mu
bufatanye bwa hafi n’inzego n’imiryango
yemerewe kwitabira mu bikorwa by’igice
kimwe cyangwa byinshi by’umuryango.
233- 3 Ubusabe ubwo ari bwo bwose
bwashyizwe ku rutonde muri nomero 229 iri
hejuru bwo kugira uruhare mu mirimo
y’Icyiciro, hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’Itegeko
Shingiro n’aya Masezerano, bwemejwe
n’ibihugu bigize Umuryango bireba
byohererezwa Umunyamabanga Mukuru. PP98
234- 4 Ubusabe ubwo ari bwo bwose
bw’urwego ruvugwa muri nimero 230
haruguru n’igihugu kigize Umuryango bireba
gikemurwa hashingiwe ku buryo
bwashyizweho n’Inama. Ubwo busabe
busuzumwa n’Inama hubahirijwe uburyo
buvugwa haruguru hamwe n'ubu buryo
bugomba gusuzumwa n'Inama. PP-98
234 A 4 bis) Ubusabe bwo kwemererwa kuba
igihugu kigize urwego muri kimwe mu bigo
bivugwa muri nomero 229 cyangwa iya 230
ivugwa haruguru bushobora no koherezwa mu
buryo butaziguye ku Munyamabanga Mukuru.
Ibihugu bigize Umuryango byasabye izo nzego
kohereza ubusabe ku Munyamabanga Mukuru
bigomba kubimenyesha ibyo bihugu. Inzego
z’igihugu kigize Umuryango zitamenyesheje
Umunyamabanga Mukuru ntabwo zifite
amahirwe yo gusaba mu buryo butaziguye.
Umunyamabanga Mukuru agomba kuvugurura
buri gihe no gutangaza urutonde rw’ibihugu
bigize Umuryango byasabye inzego
hakurikijwe ububasha cyangwa ubusugire
bwabyo bwo gusaba mu buryo butaziguye. PP98
234B 4 ter) Mu gihe yakira mu buryo buziguye
ubusabe bw’urwego buhuye na nomero 234
haruguru, Umunyamabanga Mukuru, ashingiye
ku bisabwa bisobanuwe n’Inama, aharanira ko
imikorere n’intego y’umukandida bigomba
kuba bihuye n’intego z’Umuryango,
Umunyamabanga Mukuru ahita amenyesha,
igihugu gisaba kubyemeza. Iyo
Umunyamabanga Mukuru atakiriye inzitizi
z’ibihugu bigize Umuryango mu gihe cy’amezi
4, yohereza telegaramu yibutsa. Iyo, mu gihe
cy’amezi 4 nyuma y’itariki yohereje
telegaramu yibutsa, Umunyamabanga Mukuru
atabonye inzitizi, ubusabe bufatwa
nk’ubwemewe. Iyo yakiriye inzitizi z’ibihugu
bigize Umuryango, Umunyamabanga Mukuru
asaba urwego rusaba kuvugana n’ibihugu
bigize Umuryango birebwa. PP-98
234C 4 quarter) Iyo gisabye ko mu buryo
butaziguye Umunyamabanga Mukuru
yohererezwa ubusabe, igihugu kigize
Umuryango gishobora kumumenyesha
kwemeza ubusabe bwose bw’urwego bijyanye
n’ububasha cyangwa ubusugire bwacyo. PP-98
235-5 Ubusabe ubwo ari bwo bwose buturutse
ku gihugu kigize Umuryango icyo ari cyo
cyose cyangwa Umuryango uvugwa kuri
nimero 231 yavuzwe haruguru (usibye
ibivugwa muri nimero 269B na 269C y’aya
Masezerano) bwo kugira uruhare mu bikorwa
by’Icyiciro byoherezwa ku banyamabanga
bakuru kandi bigakorwa bikurikije inzira
zashyizweho n'Inama. PP-06
236- 6 Ubusabe ubwo ari bwo bwose
bw’Umuryango buvugwa mu nomero 269B
kugeza ku ya 269D y’aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga mu kugira uruhare mu mirimo
y’urwego bwohererezwa Umunyamabanga
Mukuru, kandi Umuryango bireba ushyirwa ku
rutonde ruvugwa muri nomero 237 hepfo. PP06
237-7 Umunyamabanga Mukuru akora kandi
abika urutonde rw’inzego zose n’imiryango
ivugwa mu nomero 229 kugeza ku ya 231 na
269B kugeza ku ya 269D y’aya Masezerano
yemerewe kugira uruhare mu mirimo ya buri
rwego kandi mu gihe gikwiye, atangaza; kandi
akwirakwiza izo ntonde mu bihugu byose
bigize Umuryango n’inzego bireba
n’Umuyobozi wa Biro bireba. Uwo muyobozi
agira inama izo nzego n’imiryango ku bikorwa
byakozwe ku cyifuzo cyabo, kandi
akabimenyesha ibihugu bigize Umuryango
bireba. PP-98 PP-06
238- 8 Ibisabwa mu kugira uruhare mu mirimo
y’Ibyiciro by’ibigo n’imiryango bigaragara ku
ntonde zivugwa muri nomero 237 yo haruguru
bivugwa muri iyi ngingo, mu ngingo ya 33 no
mu zindi ngingo z’ingenzi z’aya Masezerano.
Ibivugwa muri nomero 25 kugeza 28 z'Itegeko
Shingiro ntibikurikizwa. PP-98
239- 9 Igihugu kigize urwego gishobora gukora
mu izina ry’igihugu kigize Umuryango
cyemeye, iyo kibimenyesheje Umuyobozi wa
Biro bireba ko cyabiherewe uburenganzira. PP94 PP-98
240- 10 Igihugu kigize urwego icyo ari cyo
cyose gifite uburenganzira bwo kureka kugira
urwo ruhare rwacyo kibimenyesha
Umunyamabanga Mukuru. Uruhare nk'urwo
rushobora kandi kuvanwaho, iyo bibaye
ngombwa, ibihugu bigize Umuryango bireba
cyangwa, mu gihe igihugu cyemejwe
hakurikijwe nimero 234C yavuzwe haruguru,
hakurikijwe ibisabwa n’ibikurikizwa
byashyizwweho n’Inama. Uku kureka kugira
uruhare gutangira gukurikizwa mu gihe
cy’amezi atandatu uhereyeku itariki imenyesha
ryakiriweho n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru. PP98 PP-06
241- 11 Umunyamabanga Mukuru asiba, ku
rutonde, inzego n’imiryango urwego urwo ari
rwo rwose cyangwa umuryango utagifite
uburenganzira bwo kugira uruhare mu mirimo
y’urwego, hakurikijwe ibipimo n’uburyo
byagenwe n'Inama.
241A 12 Inteko cyangwa inama y’urwego
ishobora gufata icyemezo cyo kwemerera
inzego cyangwa imiryango kugira uruhare
nk’ihuriweho mu mirimo y’itsinda runaka
cyangwa udutsinda twayo hakurikijwe
amahame avugwa hepfo: PP -98
241B 1) Urwego cyangwa umuryango uvugwa
muri nomero 229 kugeza ku ya 231 haruguru
rushobora gusaba kugira uruhare mu murimo
w’itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi nk’urwego
bifatanyije PP-98
241C 2) Mu gihe urwego rwafashe icyemezo
cyo kwemerera Ubufatanye, Umunyamabanga
mukuru akurikiza, ku bisaba, ingingo zijyanye
n'iyi ngingo, hitawe ku bunini bw'urwego
cyangwa umuryango ndetse n'ibindi bipimo
ibyo ari byo byose bifatika. PP-98
241D 3) Ibyemerewe ubufatanye byemerewe
kugira uruhare mu mirimo y’itsinda rishinzwe
ubushakashatsi ntibigaragara ku rutonde
ruvugwa muri nimero 237 yavuzwe haruguru.
PP-98
241E 4) Ibisabwa kugira uruhare mu mirimo
y’itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi bisobanuwe muri
nimero 248B na 483A z’aya Masezerano. PP98

articles.heading: Gukora imirimo y’itsinda rishinzwe ubushakashatsi 242- 1 Inteko y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi, inteko rusange y’ubuziranenge
articles.text:
bw’itumanaho hamwe n’inama mpuzamahanga
y’iterambere ry’itumanaho ishyiraho Perezida
na visi-perezida umwe cyangwa benshi wa buri
tsinda ry’ubushakashatsi. Mu gushyiraho ba
Perezida na ba visi-Perezida, hitabwa ku
bisabwa by’ubushobozi hamwe n’ibisabwa
kugira ngo habeho igabana rishingiye ku
miterere y’isi ringana, no ku bikenewe mu
guteza imbere uruhare rw’ibihugu bikiri mu
nzira y'amajyambere. PP-98
243- 2 Iyo ingano y’umurimo w’itsinda iryo ari
ryo ryose rishinzwe ubushakashatsi ibisaba,
inteko cyangwa inama ishyiraho abandi ba visiperezida ibona ko ari ngombwa. PP-98
244- 3 Iyo, hagati y’inteko ebyiri cyangwa
inama z’urwego bireba, Perezida w’itsinda
rishinzwe ubushakashatsi adashobora gukora
imirimo ashinzwe kandi ari visi-perezida umwe
gusa washyizweho, uwo asimbura perezida. Ku
bijyanye n’itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi
bwashyizweho n’umuyobozi wungirije urenze
umwe, itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi, mu nama
ikurikira, ritoramo Perezida mushya muri bo,
iyo ari ngombwa, visi-perezida mushya mu
bagize itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi. Itora kandi
visi-perezida mushya mu gihe umwe mu ba
visi-perezida bayo adashoboye gukora imirimo
ye muri icyo gihe.
245- 4 Amatsinda y’ubushakashatsi akora akazi
kayo, uko bishoboka kose, binyuze mu
nyandiko, hakoreshejwe uburyo bugezweho
bw’itumanaho.
246- 5 Umunyamabanga mukuru wa Biro ya
buri Rwego, yitaye ku byemezo by’inama
cyangwa inteko ibifitiye ububasha, nyuma yo
kugisha inama Umunyamabanga Mukuru na
nyuma yo guhuza ibiteganywa n’Itegeko
Shingiro n’Amasezerano, ashyiraho gahunda
rusange y’inama za komite ishinzwe
ubushakashatsi.
246A 5 bis) 1) Ibihugu bigize Umuryango
n’ibigize inzego byemera ibibazo bigomba
kwigwa hakurikijwe uburyo bwashyizweho
n’inama cyangwa inteko ibifitiye ububasha, iyo
bikwiye, hakubiyemo ibyerekana cyane cyane
niba icyifuzo icyo ari cyo cyose cyakagombye
kugirwaho inama ku mugaragaro n’ibihugu
bigize Umuryango. PP-98
246B 2) Ibitekerezo biva mu bushakashatsi
bw’ibibazo byavuzwe haruguru byakirwa
n’itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi hakurikijwe inzira
zashyizweho n’inama cyangwa inteko ibifitiye
ububasha, iyo bikwiye. Ibyo bitekerezo
bidasaba kugisha inama ibihugu bigize
Umuryango kugira ngo byemezwe bifatwa
nk’ibyemewe. PP-98
246C 3) Igitekerezo gisaba kugirwaho inama
n’ibihugu bigize Umuryango bigomba
gusuzuma hakurikijwe ibiteganywa na nomero
247 iri hepfo cyangwa kikoherezwa mu nama
cyangwa mu nteko bireba, iyo bibaye
ngombwa. PP-98
246D 4) Nomero ya 246A n’iya 246B haruguru
ntizigomba gukoreshwa ku bibazo

articles.heading: Imikorere n'imiterere 118-11) inshingano z’Urwego rushinzwe Iterambere ry’itumanaho ni ukugera ku ntego
articles.text:
z’Umuryango nk'uko bivugwa mu ngingo ya
mbere y’iri Tegeko Shingiro no gukora, mu
bushobozi bwarwo bwihariye, inshingano
ebyiri z’Umuryango nk’ikigo cyihariye
cy’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ndetse nk’ikigo
gishinzwe gushyira mu bikorwa imishinga mu
rwego rwa gahunda y’iterambere y’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye cyangwa izindi gahunda
zijyanye n’inkunga, hagamijwe korohereza no
kuzamura iterambere ry’ itumanaho hatangwa,
hategurwa kandi hahuzwa ibikorwa mu gutanga
ubufasha no gukorera hamwe mu bya tekiniki.
119- 2) Inzego zishinzwe itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi, ubuziranenge bw’itumanaho
n’iterambere ry’itumanaho zigomba gukorera
hamwe mu buryo bwa hafi mu bijyanye
n’ibibazo bifite aho bihuriye n’iterambere,
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’iri Tegeko Shingiro.
120- 2 Ku bijyanye n’ibyavuzwe haruguru,
inshingano zihariye z’urwego rushinzwe
iterambere ry’itumanaho ni:
121 a) kongera urwego rw’imenyekanisha
ry’abafata ibyemezo mu bijyanye n’uruhare
rukomeye rw’itumanaho muri gahunda
z’ibihugu mu iterambere ry’ubukungu
n’imibereho myiza ndetse no gutanga amakuru
n’inama ku mahitamo ashoboka ku miterere
n’umurongo wa politiki rusange;
CS / Ingingo ya 21
122 b) kuzamura, cyane cyane binyuze mu
bufatanye, iterambere, iyagura n’ikoresha
ry’imiyoboro na serivisi by’itumanaho, cyane
cyane mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira
y'amajyambere, hitabwa ku bikorwa by’izindi
nzego bireba, hongerwa uburyo mu guteza
imbere abakozi, igenamigambi, imicungire,
iyegeranya mutungo ndetse no mu
bushakashatsi n'iterambere; PP-98
123 c) kwagura itumanaho binyuze mu
bufatanye n’imiryango y’itumanaho mu karere
ndetse n’ibigo bitanga inkunga y’iterambere ku
isi no mu karere, hakurikiranwa imigendekere
y’imishinga ikubiye muri gahunda
y’umuryango y’iterambere, kugira ngo
ishyirwe mu bikorwa neza;
124 d) gukora ibikorwa byo kwegeranya
umutungo kugira ngo hatangwe ubufasha mu
bihugu biri mu nzira y'amajyambere mu rwego
rw’itumanaho, binyuze mu gushishikariza
ishyirwaho ry’imirongo y’inguzanyo ihagije
kandi yihariye ndetse no gufatanya n’imiryango
ku rwego mpuzamanga no mu karere itera
inkungu n’ishinzwe iterambere;
125 e) guteza imbere no guhuza gahunda zo
kwihutisha ihererekanya ry’ikoranabuhanga
rikenewe mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira
y'amajyambere hashingiwe ku ihindagurika
n'impinduka zibayeho mu miyoboro y'ibihugu
byateye imbere;
126 f) gushishikariza uruhare rw’inganda mu
iterambere ry’itumanaho mu bihugu biri mu
nzira y'amajyambere, no gutanga inama ku
mahitamo n’ihererekanya ry’ikoranabuhanga
rikenewe;
127 g) gutanga inama, gokora cyangwa gutera
inkunga inyigo, aho bikwiye, ku bibazo
bijyanye na tekiniki, ubukungu, imari,
imicungire, ubugenzunzi n’umuronngo wa
politiki rusange, harimo inyigo ku mishinga
yihariye mu rwego rw’itumanaho;
128 h) Gukorana n’izindi nzego,
Ubunyamabanga Bukuru n’izindi nzego bireba
gutegura gahunda rusange y’imiyoboro
y’itumanaho ku rwego mpuzamahanga no mu
karere, kugira ngo habeho uguhuza iterambere
ryabyo hagamijwe gutanga serivisi
z’itumanaho;
CS / Ingingo ya 22
129 i) kwita cyane, mu gusohoza inshingano

bitaratera imbere cyane.

articles.heading: Abayobozi batowe n'abakozi b'Umuryango 150- 1 1) Mu gukora inshingano zabo, abayobozi batowe n’abakozi b’Umuryango
articles.text:
ntibagomba gusaba cyangwa kwakira
amabwiriza ya guverinoma iyo ari yo yose
cyangwa ubundi buyobozi ubwo ari bwo bwose
butari ubwo mu muryango. Bagomba kwirinda
igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose kidahuye
n’ibigenga abakozi bakorera imiryango ku
rwego mpuzamahanga.
151- 2) Ibihugu bigize Umuryango n’abagize
inzego bubahiriza imiterere y’akazi ku rwego
mpuzamahanga igenga inshingano z’abo
bayobozi batowe n’abakozi b’Umuryango,
kandi bakirinda kugira uruhare kuri bo mu gihe
buzuza inshingano zabo. PP-98
152- 3) Nta muyobozi watowe cyangwa
umukozi b'Umuryango bagomba kugira
uruhare cyangwa inyungu z’amafaranga, mu
buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose, mu kigo icyo ari
cyo cyose cy’itumanaho. Ariko, ijambo
"inyungu z’amafaranga" ntirigomba
kumvikana nko kubuza gukomeza gutanga
amafaranga ya pansiyo kubera akazi cyangwa
serivisi byatanzwe.
153- 4) Kugira ngo habeho imikorere myiza
y’Umuryango, igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose
kigize Umuryango kivamo uwatorewe kuba
Umunyamabanga mukuru, Umunyamabanga
mukuru wungirije cyangwa umuyobozi w’ibiro
kigomba, aho bishoboka hose, kwirinda
gutumaho uwo muyobozi mu gihe kiri hagati
y’inama ebyiri z’ababifitiye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu byabo. PP-98
154- 2 Ikigenderwaho cyane mu guha akazi
umukozi no kugena imiterere y’akazi ni ibiba
bikenewe muri serivisi z’Umuryango
zigatangwa n’abantu bafite ubushobozi bwo
gukora neza kandi b’inyangamugayo ku rwego
rwo hejuru. Ibyiza byo gushakira abakozi mu
turere twinshi dutandukanye bigomba guhabwa
agaciro.

articles.heading: Icyicaro cy’Umuryango 175 Umuryango ufite icyicaro i Jeneve
Ububasha bwose mu nama 324- 1 Intumwa zoherejwe, mu nama y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
articles.text:
byabo, mu nama y’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi cyangwa inama mpuzamahanga
y’itumanaho, n’igihugu kigize Umuryango
zigomba kwemererwa mu buryo bukurikije
ibivugwa muri nimero 325 kugeza ku ya 331
ziri hepfo. PP-98
325- 2 1) Intumwa mu nama z’ababifitiye
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu byabo binyuze
mu nyandiko zashyizweho umukono
n’umukuru w’igihugu, cyangwa umukuru wa
Guverinoma, cyangwa na Minisitiri
w’Ububanyi n’amahanga.
326- 2) Kwemerera intumwa mu zindi nama
zivugwa muri nomero 324 haruguru bikorwa
hashingiwe ku nyandiko zashyizweho
umukono n’umukuru w’igihugu, n’umukuru
wa guverinoma, na Minisitiri w’Ububanyi
n’amahanga cyangwa na Minisitiri ufite
ububasha ku bibazo byakemuwe mu gihe
cy’inama.
327- 3) Haseguriwe iyemezwa rikozwe
n’umwe mu bayobozi bavugwa mu numero 325
cyangwa 326 yavuzwe haruguru, kandi
ryakiriwe mbere yo gushyira umukono ku
byemezo bizoza, intumwa zishobora
koherezwa by'agateganyo n'umuyobozi
w'itsinda ry’abahagarariye igihugu mu
mahanga ry’igihugu kigize Umuryango bireba
kuri guverinoma yakiriye inama cyangwa iyo
inama yabereye mu Ihuriro ry’Ubusuwisi,
n’umuyobozi w’intumwa zihoraho z’igihugu
kigize Umuryango bireba ku Biro
by’Umuryango w’Abibumbye i Geneve. PP-98
328- 3 Ububasha bwose bwemerwa iyo
bwashyizweho umukono n’umuyobozi
ubifitiye ububasha uvugwa muri nimero 325
kugeza ku ya 327 ziri haruguru kandi iyo yujuje
kimwe muri ibi bikurikira:
329 - gutanga ububasha bwose ku ntumwa;
330 - guha intumwa uburenganzira bwo
guhagararira guverinoma zabo nta mbogamizi;
331- guha intumwa cyangwa bamwe mu
bazigize uburenganzira bwo gushyira umukono
ku byemezo bisoza.
332 - 4 1) Intumwa zifite ububasha bwose
bwemewe n’amategeko y’inteko rusange zifite
uburenganzira bwo gutora igihugu kigize
Umuryango bireba, hashingiwe ku biteganywa
na nomero ya 169 n’iya 210 z’Itegeko Shingiro,
no gushyira umukono ku byemezo bisoza. PP98
333- 2) Intumwa zifite ububasha bwose
bidakurikije ibiteganywa n’amategeko n’inama
y’ibanze ntizifite uburenganzira bwo gutora
cyangwa gushyira umukono ku byemezo bisoza
igihe cyose iki kibazo kizaba kitarakemurwa.
334 - 5 Ububasha bwose bushyikirizwa
Ubunyamabanga bw’inama byihuse ; ku
bw’ibyo, ibihugu bigize Umuryango bigomba
kubanza kohereza ku Munyamabanga mukuru
ububasha bwose mbere y’itariki yo gutangiza
inama, na we akabugeza ku Bunyamabanga
bw’inama bukimara kujyaho. Komisiyo ivugwa
muri nimero 68 y’Amategeko Rusange agenga
inama, inteko n’inama z’Umuryango ishinzwe
kubigenzura ; kandi ikerekana raporo yayo mu
nama rusange mu gihe cyagenwe. Mu gihe
hagitegerejwe icyemezo cy'inama rusange kuri
iki kibazo, intumwa zose zifite uburenganzira
bwo kugira uruhare muri uwo murimo no
gukoresha uburenganzira bwo gutora
bw’igihugu kigize Umuryango bireba. PP-98
PP-02
335- 6 Nk’uko bisanzwe, ibihugu bigize
Umuryango bigomba kwihatira kohereza
intumwa zabyo mu nama z’Umuryango.
Icyakora, iyo ku bw’impamvu zidasanzwe
ibihugu bigize Umuryango bidashobora
kohereza intumwa zabyo, bishobora guha
intumwa z’ibindi bihugu bigize Umuryango
ububasha bwo gutora no gushyiraho umukono
mu izina ryabyo. Iryo tangwa ry’ububasha
rigomba kugira inyandiko ishyizweho
umukono n’umwe mu bayobozi bavugwa muri
numero 325 cyangwa iya 326 zavuzwe
haruguru. PP-98

gutora zishobora guha izindi ntumwa zifite
uburenganzira bwo gutora kugira ngo zikoreshe
ubwo burenganzira bwo gutora mu nama imwe
cyangwa nyinshi bidashoboka ko zitabira. Ku
bw’ibyo, muri ibyo bihe igomba kubimenyesha
umuyobozi w'inama mu nyandiko.
337- 8 Intumwa ntizishobora guhabwa
ububasha bwo gutora ijwi rirenze rimwe.
338- 9 Ububasha no gutanga ububasha
byoherejwe hakoreshejwe telegaramu ntabwo
byemewe. Icyakora, telegaramu z’ibisubizo ku
busabe bw’ibisobanuro bya perezida cyangwa
by’Ubunyamabanga bw'inama irebana
n’ububasha iremewe.
339- 10 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango cyangwa
ikigo cyemewe cyangwa umuryango uteganya
kohereza intumwa cyangwa abagihagarariye
mu nteko ishinzwe ubuziranenge
bw’itumanaho, inama y’iterambere
ry’itumanaho cyangwa inteko y’itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi babimenyesha
Umuyobozi wa Biro y’urwego bireba, berekana

ry’intumwa cyangwa ababihagarariye. PP-98

articles.text:

umukono ku byemezo bizosa, bishobora

Shingiro cyangwa kuri aya Masezerano kugeza
