gahunda zemejwe n’inama kandi bihuye
n’amabwiriza agenga imari, agomba kuba
akubiyemo ingingo zidasanzwe zijyanye no
kwemera no gukoresha iyo misanzu ku
bushake. PP-94
487- 2) Umunyamabanga mukuru atanga
raporo ijyanye n’iyo misanzu itangwa ku
bushake mu Nama muri raporo y’imicungire
y’imari no mu nyandiko yerekana muri make
inkomoko n’imikoreshereze yateganyijwe
n’imyanzuro yateganyijwe ijyanye na buri
musanzu watanzwe ku bushake. PP-94
CV / Ingingo ya 34

articles.heading: Ihagarikwa ry’itumanaho 180-1 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango bifite uburenganzira bwo guhagarika, hakurikijwe
articles.text:
amategeko yabyo yo mu gihugu, ikwirakwizwa
ry’ubutumwa ubwo ari bwo bwose bwigenga
bugaragara nk’ikibazo ku mutekano w’igihugu
cyangwa bunyuranyije n’amategeko yacyo,
ituze rusange rya rubanda cyangwa imyitwarire
myiza mu gihugu, nyuma yuko bimenyesha
ibiro bwavuyemo ihagarikwa ryabwo cyangwa
kimwe mu bibugize, keretse mu gihe bigaragara
ko iryo menyekanisha rishobora guteza ikibazo
ku mutekano w’igihugu. PP98
181-2 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango kandi na none
bifite uburenganzira bwo guhagarika,
hakurikijwe amategeko yabyo yo mu gihugu,
irindi tumanaho iryo ari ryo ryose ryigenga
rishobora kugaragara nk’irateza ikibazo ku
mutekano w’igihugu cyangwa rinyuranyije
n’amategeko yacyo, umutuzo mu gihugu
cyangwa imyitwarire myiza mu gihugu. PP-98
CS / Ingingo ya 35

articles.heading: Indimi 490-1 1) Indimi zindi zitari izivugwa mu ngingo zijyanye n'ingingo ya 29 y'Itegeko Shingiro zishobora gukoreshwa: PP-98
articles.text:
491 a) iyo Umunyamabanga Mukuru asabye
ikoreshwa ry’imvugo cyangwa inyandiko iri
mu rurimi rumwe cyangwa izindi nyinshi, haba
burundu cyangwa ku buryo bw’agateganyo,
hashingiwe ko mafaranga y’inyongera
yatanzwe n’ibihugu bigize Umuryango
byakoze cyangwa byashyigikiye ubusabe; PP98
492 b) iyo, mu nama no mu nama
z’Umuryango, nyuma yo kubimenyesha
Umunyamabanga Mukuru cyangwa
Umuyobozi wa Biro bireba, intumwa iyo ari yo
yose ubwayo ifata ingamba zo kwiyishyirira
ubusemuzi bw’ururimi rwayo bujya mu zindi
izo ari zo zose zivugwa mu ngingo zijyanye
n'ingingo ya 29 y'Itegeko Shingiro. PP-98
493- 2) Mu bihe biteganyijwe muri nomero 491
yavuzwe haruguru, Umunyamabanga Mukuru
agomba kubahiriza uko bishoboka kose, amaze
kubona ibihugu bigize uyu Muryango bireba ko
amafaranga yakoreshejwe azayishyurwa
n’Umuryango mu buryo bukwiye. PP-98
CV / Ingingo ya 35
494- 3) Mu bihe biteganyijwe muri nimero 492
yavuzwe haruguru, intumwa bireba zishobora
kandi, iyo zibyifuza, gutanga amafaranga yazo
kugira ngo hakorwe ubusemuzi mu rurimi
rwazo buvanywe muri rumwe mu ndimi
zivugwa mu ngingo bireba y'ingingo ya 29
y'Itegeko Shingiro.
495- 2 Inyandiko izo ri zo zose zivugwa mu
ngingo zijyanye n’ingingo ya 29 y’Itegeko
Shingiro zishobora gutangazwa mu rundi
rurimi rutari urwavuzwe haruguru hitawe ko
ibihugu bigize Umuryango bisaba ko iyo
nyandiko byiyemeza kwishyura amafaranga
yose y’ubusemuzi no gutangaza inyandiko
zayo. PP-98
CV / Ingingo ya 36
UMUTWE WA V: INGINGO
ZINYURANYE ZIJYANYE
N'IMIKORESHEREZE YA SERIVISI
Z'ITUMANAHO

articles.heading: Inshingano 183 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango ntibyemera uburyozwe ubwo ari bwo bwose ku bakoresha
articles.text:
serivisi mpuzamahanga z’itumanaho, cyane
cyane ku birego bigamije kwaka indishyi. PP98

articles.heading: Gushyiraho no kwishyura amafaranga 497- 1 Kwishyuza konti mpuzamahanga bifatwa nk’ibikorwa by’ubu by’imari kandi
articles.text:
bigakorwa hashingiwe ku nshingano
mpuzamahanga z’ibihugu bigize Umuryango
bireba, igihe guverinoma zabyo zakoze
amasezerano kuri iyo. Mu gihe hatabayeho ayo
Masezerano cyangwa iyo hatabayeho
amasezerano adasanzwe yakozwe, hashingiwe
ku biteganywa n’ingingo ya 42 y’Itegeko
Shingiro, uko kwishyurwa bikorwa hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’amabwiriza y’ubuyobozi. PP-98
498- 2 Ubuyobozi bw’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango n’ibigize urwego bifitemo inyungu
bikora serivisi z’itumanaho mpuzamahanga
bigomba kumvikana ku mubare w’amafaranga
bishyura cyangwa bishyurwa. PP-98
499- 3 Konti zijyanye n’amafaranga yishyuzwa
n’ayishyurwa zivugwa muri nomero 498
zavuzwe haruguru zishyirwaho hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’amabwiriza y’ubuyobozi, uretse
iyo hakozwe amasezerano adasanzwe hagati
y’impande bireba.
CV/ Ingingo ya 38

articles.heading: Gushyiraho, gukoresha no kurinda imiyoboro n'ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu itumanaho 186- 1 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango bifata
articles.text:
ingamba zikenewe zo gushyiraho, mu mikorere
myiza mu bya tekiniki, imiyoboro n’ibikoresho
bikoreshwa bikenewe kugira ngo habeho
itumanaho mpuzamahanga ryihuse kandi
ridacikagurika. PP-98
187- 2 Mu gihe gishoboka, iyi miyoboro
n’ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu itumanaho
bigomba gukoreshwa mu buryo no mu nzira
byagiye byigaragaza ko bikoramo neza.
Bigomba kuba biri mu rwego rwiza rwo kuba
byakoreshwa kandi bigahora bigendana
n’urwego rw’iterambere mu bya siyansi na
tekiniki.
188- 3 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango birinda iyo
miyoboro n’ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu
itumanaho biri mu bubasha bwabyo. PP-98
189- 4 Usibye habaye hariho Amasezerano
yihariye ashyiraho ubundi buryo bwihariye,
buri gihugu kigize Umuryango gifata ingamba
zikwiye kugira ngo ibyo bice bihuza imiyoboro
mpuzamahanga y’itumanaho aho gishinzwe
bijye bikurikiranwa. PP-98
189A 5 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango byemera ko
ari ngombwa gufata ingamba zishoboka zo
gukumira ko imikorere y’ibikoresho
by’amashanyarazi n’ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu
itumanaho by’ubwoko bwose bitabangamira
imikorere y’ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu
itumanaho biherereye mu bubasha bw’ibindi
bihugu bigize Umuryango. PP-98

articles.heading: Gushyikirana mu itumanaho 501-1 Sitasiyo zitanga itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwio mu itumanaho rya serivisi
articles.text:
ngendanwa zubahirizwa, mu birebwa
n’inshingano zabo zisanzwe, mu guhanahana
amakuru atangwa mu buryo bw’amajwi nta
tandukanyirizo rya gahunda ya radio yemewe
na zo.
502- 2 Icyakora, mu rwego rwo kutabangamira
iterambere ry’ubumenyi, ibivugwa muri
nomero 501 haruguru ntibishobora kubuza
ikoreshwa rya gahunda ya radiyo idashobora
kuvugana n’izindi gahunda, hashingiwe ko
ubwo bushobozi buke buterwa n’imiterere
yihariye y’izo gahunda kandi atari impamvu
y’ibikoresho byemewe gusa hamwe n’ikintu
cyo gukumira itumanaho.
503- 3 Bitabangamiye ibivugwa muri nomero
501 haruguru, sitasiyo ishobora guhabwa
serivisi mpuzamahanga z’itumanaho zibujijwe,
zigenwa ku bw’iyi ntego cyangwa n’ibindi bihe
bitagendeye ku buryo bukoreshwa.
Cv / Ingingo ya 40

articles.heading: Ururimi rw’ibanga 504 - 1 Telegaramu za Leta, kimwe na telegaramu ya serivisi, zishobora kwandikwa
articles.text:
mu rurimi rw’ibanga mu mibanire yose.
505-2 Telegaramu yigenga mu rurimi
rw’ibanga ishobora kwakirwa hagati y’ibihugu
byose bigize Umuryango usibye
ibimenyeshejwe vuba, binyuze mu
Bunyamabanga bukuru, ko bitemera uru rurimi
kuri iki cyiciro cy’iyandikirana. PP-98
506- 3 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango bitemera
telegaramu yigenga mu rurimi rw’ibanga
bikomoka cyangwa bigenewe akarere kabo
bigomba kubyemerera inzira, keretse iyo
bihagaritse imirimo iteganyijwe mu ngingo ya
35 y'Itegeko Shingiro. PP-98
CV / Ingingo ya 41
UMUTWE WA VI: UBUKEMURAMPAKA
N’IVUGURURWA

articles.heading: Ubukemurampaka: Inzira (reba ingingo ya 56 y'Itegeko Shingiro) 507- 1 Uruhande rujuririra ubukemurampaka
articles.text:
rutangiza inzira y’ubukemurampaka rugeza ku
rundi ruhande bifitanye amakimbirane
imenyesha risaba ubukemurampaka.
508- 2 Impande zihitamo ku bwumvikane niba
ubukemurampaka bugomba guhabwa abantu,
ubuyobozi cyangwa za guverinoma. Iyo, mu
gihe cy'ukwezi kumwe uhereye igihe
zamenyesherejweho gusaba ubukemurampaka,
impande zitashoboye kumvikana kuri iyi
ngingo, ubukemurampaka buhabwa
guverinoma.
509- 3 Iyo ubukemurampaka bwahawe abantu
ku giti cyabo, abakemurampaka ntibagomba
kuba abenegihugu b’igihugu kiri mu
makimbirane, cyangwa ngo bature muri kimwe
muri ibyo bihugu, cyangwa ngo babe
bahagarariye imirimo yabyo.
510- 4 Iyo ubukemurampaka bwahawe za
guverinoma cyangwa ubuyobozi bwazo,
bigomba gutoranywa mu bihugu bigize
Umuryango bitagize uruhare mu makimbirane,
ariko bikaba bikiri muri aya Masezerano,
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryatumye haba
amakimbirane. PP-98
511 - 5 Mu mezi atatu uhereye ku itariki yo
kwakira imenyesha ry'ubusabe
bw’ubukemurampaka, buri ruhande mu
mpande zombi zagiranye amakimbirane
rushyiraho umukemurampaka.
512 - 6 Iyo impande zirenze ebyiri zagize
uruhare muri ayo makimbirane, buri ruhande
muri ayo matsinda abiri y’impande afite
inyungu rusange mu makimbirane rushyiraho
umukemurampaka hakurikijwe uburyo
buteganyijwe muri nomero 510 na nomero 511
zavuzwe haruguru.
CV / Ingingo ya 41
513- 7 Abakemurampaka babiri bashyizweho
bahitamo umukemurampaka wa gatatu, iyo
abakemurampaka babiri ba mbere ari abantu ku
giti cyabo atari guverinoma cyangwa
ubuyobozi, bagomba kubahiriza ibisabwa
bivugwa muri nimero 509 yavuzwe haruguru,
byongeye kandi ntibagomba kuba bafite
ubwenegihugu bumwe n’abandi
bakemurampaka babiri. Mu gihe hatabaye
ubwumvikane hagati y’abakemurampaka babiri
ku bijyanye no guhitamo umukemurampaka wa
gatatu, buri wese muri aba bakemurampaka
babiri atoranya umukemurampaka wa gatatu
udafite inyungu muri aya makimbirane.
Umunyamabanga Mukuru akoresha tombola
kugira ngo ahitemo umukemurampaka wa
gatatu.
514- 8 Impande zagiranye amakimbirane
zishobora kwemeranya ko amakimbirane yazo
akemurwa n’umukemurampaka umwe
washyizweho ku bwumvikane ; zishobora
kandi gushyiraho umukemurampaka zigasaba
Umunyamabanga Mukuru gukoresha tombola
mu kwemeza umukemurampaka umwe mu
batoye ugomba gukora wenyine.
515 - 9 Umukemurampaka cyangwa
abakemurampaka bahitamo mu bwisanzure
ahantu n’amategeko azakoreshwa muri ubwo
bukemurampaka.
516- 10 Icyemezo cy’umukemurampaka umwe
kiba ndakuka kandi cyubahirizwa n’impande
zifitanye amakimbirane. Iyo ubukemurampaka
bwatanzwe n’umukemurampaka urenze umwe,
icyemezo cyafashwe ku bwiganze bw'amajwi
y'abakemurampaka kiba ndakuka kandi
kikubahirizwa n’impande zifitanye
amakimbirane.
517- 11 Buri ruhande rwishyura amafaranga
rwakoresheje mu gihe cy’iperereza no
gutangiza ubukemurampaka. Amafaranga
y'ubukemurampaka, atari ayo yatanzwe
n'impande ubwazo, agabanywa ku buryo
bungana impande zifitanye amakimbirane.
518- 12 Umuryango utanga amakuru yose
ajyanye n’amakimbirane abakemurampaka
bashobora gukenera. Iyo impande zifitanye
amakimbirane zibyemeranyijeho, icyemezo
cy'abakemurampaka kimenyeshwa
Umunyamabanga Mukuru kugira ngo
kizashingirweho mu gihe kizaza.
CV/ Ingingo ya 42

articles.heading: Ingingo zo kuvugurura aya Masezerano 519- 1 Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kigize Umuryango gishobora gusaba ko habaho
articles.text:
ivugururwa iryo ari ryose ry’aya Masezerano.
Icyifuzo nk'icyi kigomba, kugira ngo gishobore
koherezwa mu bihugu byose bigize Umuryango
bikagisuzuma mu gihe gikwiye, kigera ku
Munyamabanga Mukuru bitarenze amezi
umunani mbere y’itariki yo gufungura yagenwe
n’inama y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu byabo. Umunyamabanga Mukuru
ashyikiriza ibihugu byose bigize Umuryango
icyifuzo vuba bishoboka bitarenze amezi
atandatu mbere y’itariki imaze kuvugwa. PP98
520- 2 Icyifuzo icyo ari cyo cyose cyo
guhindura ivugururwa ryasabwe iryo ari ryo
ryose ryoherejwe hakurikijwe ibiteganywa na
nimero 519 ivugwa haruguru, gishobora
gutangwa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose n’igihugu
kigize Umuryango cyangwa n’intumwa zacyo
mu nama y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu byabo. PP-98
521- 3 Umubare wa ngombwa usabwa mu
nama rusange y’Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu byabo kugira ngo
hasuzumwe icyifuzo icyo ari cyo cyose cyo
kuvugurura aya Masezerano cyangwa
guhindura icyo cyifuzo ugizwe na kimwe cya
kabiri cy’intumwa zemewe mu nama
y’abahagarariye ibihugu byabo babifitiye
ububasha.
522- 4 Kugira ngo hemezwe, icyifuzo icyo ari
cyo cyose cyo guhindura ivugururwa
riteganyijwe, kimwe n’ivugururwa
ryateganijwe ryose, ryahinduwe cyangwa
ritarahinduye, mu nama rusange, hamwe
n’abarenze kimwe cya kabiri cy’intumwa mu
nama y’abahagarariye ibihugu byabo babifitiye
ububasha bemewe kandi bafite uburenganzira
bwo gutora.
523-5 Amategeko rusange agenga inama,
inteko n’inama z’Umuryango birakurikizwa,
uretse ibika bibanziriza iyi ngingo byiganje,
bibiteganya ukundi. PP-98 PP-02
CV / Ingingo ya 42
524 - 6 Ivugururwa iryo ari ryo ryose ry’aya
Masezerano ryemejwe n’inama y’ababifitiye
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu byabo, muri
rusange kandi mu buryo bw’inyandiko imwe
y’ivugururwa, ku munsi uzashyirwaho
n’Inama, hagati y’ibihugu bigize Umuryango
yabitswe mbere y’iyo tariki inyandiko yabyo yo
kwemeza burundu, kwemera cyangwa
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano n’inyandiko yo kuvugurura.
Kwemeza burundu, kwemera cyangwa
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano, igice cy’iy’inyandiko
y’ivugurura gusa ntibirimo. PP-98
525- 7 Haseguriwe nomero 524 yavuzwe
haruguru, Inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu byabo ishobora kwemeza
ko ivugururwa ry’aya Masezerano rikwiye mu
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryiza rishobora kwemeza
ko hakenewe ivugururwa ry’aya Masezerano
kugira ngo hakurikizwe neza Itegeko Shingiro.
Muri icyo gihe, ivugururwa ry’aya Masezerano
ntirishobora gutangira gukurikizwa mbere
y’uko itegeko Shingiro ritangira gukurikizwa.
526- 8 Umunyamabanga Mukuru amenyesha
ibihugu byose bigize Umuryango ibijyanye na
buri nyandiko yo kwemeza burundu, kwemera,
cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano. PP-98
527- 9 Nyuma yo gutangira gukurikizwa
kw'inyandiko iyo ari yo yose y’ivugururwa,
kwemeza burundu, kwemera cyangwa
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’ingingo ya 52 n'iya 53 z'Itegeko Shingiro
bikurikizwa ku Masezerano yavuguruwe.
528-10 Nyuma yo gutangira gukurikizwa
kw’inyandiko y’ivugururwa iyo ari yo yose,
Umunyamabanga Mukuru ayandikisha mu
Bunyamabanga bw’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye, hakurikijwe ibivugwa mu
ngingo ya 102 y’Amasezerano mpuzamahanga
ashyiraho Umuryango w’Abibumbye. Nomero
241 y'Itegeko Shingiro ikoreshwa no ku
nyandiko iyo ari yo yose y’ ivugururwa.
UMUGEREKA:
Ibisobanuro by'amagambo amwe n'amwe
akoreshwa muri aya Masezerano no mu
Mabwiriza y’ubuyobozi y’Umuryango
mpuzamahanga w’Itumanaho
Ku bw’inyandiko z’Umuryango ziri haruguru,
amagambo akurikira, agira ukumvikana
gutangwa n’ibisobanuro biijyanye na yo:
1001 Impuguke: Umuntu woherejwe na:
a) Guverinoma cyangwa ubuyobozi bw'igihugu
cye, cyangwa
b) ikigo cyangwa Umuryango byemewe
hakurikijwe ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 19 y'aya
Masezerano, cyangwa
c) umuryango mpuzamahanga,
kwitabira mu mirimo y’Umuryango bireba mu
bikorwa by’ubushobozi bw’umwuga.
1002 Indorerezi : Umuntu woherejwe
n’igihugu kigize Umuryango, urwego cyangwa
ikigo kugira ngo yitabire inama, inteko
cyangwa inama y’Umuryango cyangwa Inama,
nta burenganzira afite bwo gutora kandi
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’ingingo zijyanye
n’inyandiko z’ibanze z’Umuryango. PP-94 PP98 PP-06
1003 Serivisi igendanwa: Serivisi
y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi hagati ya
sitasiyo zigendanwa na sitasiyo zo ku butaka,
cyangwa hagati ya sitasiyo zigendanwa.
1004 Umuryango w’ubumenyi cyangwa
inganda: Umuryango uwo ari wo wose, utari
uwa Leta cyangwa ikigo cya Leta, ukora
ubushakashatsi bw’ibibazo by’itumanaho no
gushushanya cyangwa gukora ibikoresho
bigenewe serivisi z’itumanaho.
CV / UMUGEREKA
1005 Itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi:
Itumanaho rikoresha ikwirakwiza ry’amajwi.
Icyitonderwa 1: Imiyoboro y’itumanaho
idakoresha insinga za radiyo ni imiyoboro
umurongo uba ari inshuro zayo ziri munsi ya
3000 GHz, zikwirakwizwa mu kirere nta
muyoboro wakozwe wifashishijwe.
Icyitonderwa 2: Bitewe n’ikigamijwe na
nomero 149 kugeza ku ya 154 y’aya
Masezerano, ijambo “itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi” ririmo kandi itumanaho
rikoresha ingufu za rukuruzi z’umurongo uri
hejuru ya GHz 3 000, rikwirakwizwa mu kirere
nta muyoboro wakozwe wifashishijwe.
1006 Itumanaho rya serivisi: Itumanaho
rijyanye n’itumanaho mpuzamahanga rya Leta
kandi rihanahanwa muri ibi bikurikira:
- ubuyobozi,
- ibigo byemewe bizwi, na
- Perezida w'Inama, Umunyamabanga Mukuru,
Umunyamabanga Mukuru wungirije,
abayobozi ba Biro, abagize komite ishinzwe
kugenzura amaradiyo cyangwa abandi
bahagarariye cyangwa abayobozi babiherewe
uburenganzira, harimo n'abashinzwe imirimo
hanze y’icyicaro cy’Umuryango.

articles.heading: Inama zo mu karere, amasezerano n’ imiryango 194 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango bifite uburenganzira bwo gukora inama zo mu karere,
articles.text:
gukora amasezerano yo mu karere no gushinga
imiryango yo mu karere, hagamijwe gukemura
ibibazo by’itumanaho bikeneye gukemurwa mu
rwego rw’akarere. Amasezerano yo mu karere
ntagomba kuvuguruza iri Tegeko Shingiro
cyangwa Amasezerano. PP-98
CS / Ingingo ya 44
UMUTWE WA VII: INGINGO ZIHARIYE
Z’ITUMANAHO RIKORESHA
INSAKAZAMAJWI

articles.heading: PP-98 imikoreshereze y’imirongo ivugirwaho ndetse n’aho ibyogajuru bigomba kuba biri n’izindi nzira zabyo zo
articles.text:
mu kirere
195- 1 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango byihatira
kugabanya umubare w’imirongo hamwe
n’ikirere ikoreramo ku buryo bushoboka kugira
ngo ibikorwa bya serivisi ikenewe bikorwe
neza. Kugira ngo bigerweho, byihatira gushyira
mu bikorwa uburyo bwa tekiniki bugezweho
bwo mu gihe cya hafi. PP-02
196- 2 Mu gukoresha imirongo ivugirwaho
muri serivisi z’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi, ibihugu bigize Umuryango
bizirikana ko imirongo ivugirwaho hamwe
n’inzira z’ibyogajuru mu kirere bijyanye,
harimo n’aho ibyogajuru bigomba kuba biri, ari
umutungo kamere udasubirwaho ugomba
gukoreshwa mu buryo bushyize mu gaciro,
bukora neza kandi budasesagura hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n'amabwiriza agenga itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi, kugira ngo ibihugu
bitandukanye cyangwa itsinda ry’ibihugu
bibashe gukoresha ibyo byogajuru biri mu
kirere n’imirongo ku buryo bungana, hitabwa
cyane cyane ku bikenewe n’ibihugu bikiri mu
nzira y' amajyambere ndetse n’imiterere
y’ahantu y’ibihugu bimwe na bimwe. PP-98

articles.heading: Ukwivanga kw’imirongo guteza ingaruka 197-1 Ibigo byose by’itangazamakuru, intego izo ari zo zose byaba bifite, bigomba
articles.text:
gushyirwaho kandi bigakoreshwa mu buryo
budatera ukwivanga kw’imirongo mu
itumanaho cyangwa serivisi z’insakazamajwi
z’ibihugu bigize Umuryango, ibigo bikora
byemewe n’ibindi bigo byahawe uburenganzira
bwo gutanga serivisi z’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi, kandi bigakora bikurikije
ibiteganywa n’amabwiriza agenga itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi. PP-98
CS / Ingingo ya 46
198- 2 Buri gihugu kigize Umuryango
cyiyemeza gusaba ibigo bikora byemewe na
cyo n’ibindi byahawe uburenganzira kubera iyo
ntego kubahiriza ibisabwa muri nimero 197
yavuzwe haruguru.
PP-98
199-3 Byongeye kandi, Ibihugu bigize
Umuryango byemera ko ari ngombwa gufata
ingamba zishoboka zo gukumira ko imikorere
y’ibikoresho by’amashanyarazi n’ibikoresho
bikoreshwa mu itumanaho by’ubwoko bwose
bidatera ukwivanga kw’imirongo mu
itumanaho cyangwa serivisi z’insakazamajwi
nkuko bivugwa muri nimero 197 yavuzwe
haruguru. PP-98

articles.heading: Ubutumwa bw’ intabaza 200 Ibigo by’itangazamakuru bisabwa kwakira ubutumwa bw’intabaza nk’ikintu kihutirwa
articles.text:
bidashidikanwa, aho bwaba buturutse hose,
ndetse no kubusubiza kandi bigahita bifata
icyemezo kijyanye na bwo bitewe n’ibisabwa.

articles.heading: Ibimenyetso by’intabaza, iby’ibyihutirwa, iby’umutekano cyangwa iby’ibiranga bitari nyabyo cyangwa
articles.text:
by’ibinyoma.
201 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango byiyemeza
gufata ingamba zikenewe zo guhashya
ihererekanya cyangwa ikwirakwizwa
ry’ibimenyetso by’intabaza, iry’ibyihutirwa,
iby’umutekano cyangwa iby’ibiranga bitari
nyabyo cyangwa by'ibinyoma ndetse no
gufatanya hagamijwe kuranga no kugaragaza
ibigo biri mu bubasha bwabyo bikwirakwiza
ibyo bimenyetso. PP-98

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho rya serivisi zishinzwe kurinda igihugu 202- 1 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango bifite ubwisanzure busesuye ku bijyanye no
articles.text:
gushyiraho insakazamajwi rya gisirikare. PP98
CS / Ingingo ya 48
203- 2 Icyakora, ibikoresho bikoreshwa,
bigomba kubahiriza ibiteganywa n’amabwiriza
yerekeranye n’ubufasha butangwa mu gihe
havutse ibibazo ndetse n’ingamba zafatwa
kugira ngo hatabaho ukwivanga kw’imirongo,
kimwe n’ibisabwa n’amabwiriza atangwa
n’ubuyobozi yerekeranye n’uburyo gutambutsa
amajwi n’ubwoko bw’imirongo byakoreshwa,
bitewe n’imiterere ya serivisi bitanga.
204- 3 Byongeye kandi, iyo ibyo bikoresho
bigira uruhare muri serivisi yo guhererekanya
amakuru mu buryo bwa rusange cyangwa mu
zindi serivisi zigengwa n’amabwiriza atangwa
n’ubuyobozi, bigomba kubahiriza, muri
rusange, ibiteganywa n’amabwiriza akurikizwa
muri izo serivisi.
CS / Ingingo ya 49
UMUTWE WA VIII: IMIBANIRE
Y’UMURYANGO N’UMURYANGO
W’ABIBUMBYE, INDI MIRYANGO
MPUZAMAHANGA NDETSE
N’IBIHUGU BITARI MU MURYANGO

articles.heading: Imibanire y’Umuryango n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye 205 Imibanire hagati y’ Umuryango w’Abibumbye n’Umuryango mpuzamahanga
articles.text:
w’Itumanaho isobanuwe mu Masezerano
yakozwe hagati y’iyi Miryango yombi.

articles.heading: Imibanire n’indi miryango mpuzamahanga 206 Mu rwego rwo kugira ngo habeho ubufatanye mpuzamahanga mu bijyanye
articles.text:
n’itumanaho, Umuryango ugomba gukorana
n’imiryango mpuzamahanga bihuje inyungu
n'ibikorwa. PP-02

articles.heading: Imibanire n’ibihugu bitari mu Muryango 207 Buri gihugu kigize Umuryango gifite, ubwacyo ndetse n’ibigo byemewe,
articles.text:
uburenganzira bwo gushyiraho ibisabwa
bigenderwaho ngo cyemere gukorana
itumanaho n’icyo gihugu kitari mu Muryango.
Iyo itumanaho rikomoka mu gihugu nk'icyo
ryemewe n’igihugu kigize Umuryango,
rigomba koherezwa kandi, kubera ko rikoresha
imiyoboro y’itumanaho y’igihugu kigize
Umuryango, rigengwa n’ingingo ziteganywa
n’iri Tegeko Shingiro, Amasezerano
n’Amabwiriza atangwa n’ubuyobozi kandi
imisoro isanzwe igakurikizwa. PP-98
CS / Ingingo ya 52
UMUTWE WA IX: INGINGO ZISOZA

articles.heading: Kwemeza burundu Itegeko Shingiro cyangwa kuryemera 208-1 Iri Tegeko Shingiro n’Amasezerano byemezwa burundu icyarimwe cyangwa
articles.text:
bikemerwa na buri gihugu icyo ari cyo cyose
kigize Umuryango cyabishyizeho umukono,
hakurikijwe Itegeko Shingiro ryacyo, mu buryo
bw’inyandiko imwe. Iyi nyandiko, mu gihe cya
vuba, ishyikirizwa Umunyamabanga mukuru.
Umunyamabanga mukuru amenyesha ibihugu
bigize Umuryango itangwa rya buri nyandiko.
PP-98
209- 2 1) Mu gihe cy’imyaka ibiri uhereye igihe
iri Tegeko Shingiro n’Amasezerano
byatangiriye gukurikizwa, buri gihugu kigize
Umuryango cyabishyizeho umukono kigira
uburenganzira buhabwa ibihugu bigize
Umuryango muri nimero ya 25 kugeza 28 z’ iri
Tegeko Shingiro, kabone nubwo cyaba
kitarashyikiriza Umunyamabanga mukuru
inyandiko yo kubyemeza burundu cyangwa yo
kubyemera hakurikijwe ibiteganywa na nimero
208 ivugwa haruguru. PP-98
210-2) Iyo igihe cy’imyaka ibiri uhereye igihe
iri Tegeko Shingiro n’Amasezerano
byatangiriye gukurikizwa kirangiye, igihugu
kigize Umuryango cyabishyizeho umukono
kitarashyikiriza Umunyamabanga mukuru
inyandiko ibyemeza burundu cyangwa
ibyemera nkuko biteganywa muri nimero 208
yavuzwe haruguru, ntikigira uburenganzira
bwo gutora mu nama iyo ari yo yose
y’Umuryango, mu nama iyo ari yo yose
y'Inama, mu nama iyo ari yo yose y’inzego
z’Umuryango, haba no kugishwa inama
binyuze mu nyandiko hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n'iri Tegeko Shingiro n'Amasezerano, kandi
ibyo bikaba igihe iyo nyadiko itaratangwa.
Uburenganzira bundi bw'icyo gihugu kigize
Umuryango ntibuhungabanywa uretse
uburenganzira bwo gutora. PP-98
211 - 3 Nyuma y’uko iri Tegeko Shingiro
n’Amasezerano bitangiye gukurikizwa
hashingiwe ku ngingo ya 58 y’iri Tegeko
Shingiro, inyandiko yemeza burundu cyangwa
yemera itangira kugira agaciro kuva ku munsi
yashyikirijwe Umunyamabanga mukuru.
CS / Ingingo ya 53

articles.heading: Kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bigize Umuryango 212-1 Igihugu kigize Umuryango kitashyize umukono kuri iri Tegeko Shingiro
articles.text:
n’Amasezerano cyangwa, hashingiwe ku
biteganywa n’ingingo ya 2 y’iri Tegeko
Shingiro, ikindi gihugu icyo ari cyo cyose
kivugwa muri iyo ngingo, gishobora kwemera
kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri iri Tegeko
Shingiro no mu Masezerano igihe icyo ari cyo
cyose. Uko kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
bihuriye kuri iri Tegeko Shingiro no ku
Masezerano bibera icyarimwe mu buryo
bw’inyandiko imwe ikubiyemo Itegeko
Shingiro n’Amasezerano. PP-98
213- 2 Inyandiko yo kwemera kuba kimwe mu
bihugu bihuriye kuri iri Tegeko Shingiro no ku
Masezerano ishyikirizwa Umunyamabanga
mukuru, na we akabimenyesha ibihugu bigize
Umuryango akimara kuyakira kandi
akoherereza inyandukuro ihuje n’umwimerere
buri gihugu kigize Umuryango. PP-98
214- 3 Nyuma y’uko iri Tegeko Shingiro
n’Amasezerano bitangiye gukurikizwa
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 58 y’iri Tegeko
Shingiro, inyandiko yo kwemera kuba kimwe
mu bihugu bihuriye kuri iri Tegeko Shingiro
n’Amasezerano itangira kugira agaciro ku
munsi yashyikirijwe Umunyamabanga mukuru,
keretse iyo nyandiko ibiteganya ukundi.

articles.heading: Amabwiriza atangwa n’ubuyobozi 215-1 Amabwiriza atangwa n’ubuyobozi, nkuko bigaragara mu ngingo ya 4 y’iri Tegeko
articles.text:
Shingiro, aba ari inyandiko mpuzamahanga
zigomba kubahirizwa kandi agomba kubahiriza
ibiteganywa n’iri Tegeko Shingiro.
CS / Ingingo ya 54
216-2 Kwemeza burundu cyangwa kwemera iri
Tegeko Shingiro n'Amasezerano cyangwa
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bibihuriyeho
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 52 n'iya 53 z'iri Tegeko
Shingiro, bisobanura kandi kwemera
gukurikiza Amabwiriza atangwa n’Ubuyobozi
yemejwe n’inama ku rwego rw’isi ibifitiye
ububasha mbere y’itariki yo gushyira umukono
kuri iri Tegeko Shingiro n’Amasezerano. Uku
kwemera kumvikana nko kuzirikana icyo ari
cyo cyose cyakozwe mu gihe cyo gushyira
umukono ku Mabwiriza atangwa n’Ubuyobozi
cyangwa ivugururwa ryayo no gukomeza
kukizirikana kugeza igihe cyo gutanga
inyandiko iyemeza burundu cyangwa iyemera
kuba kimwe mu bihugu bigize Umuryango.
216A 2 bis) Amabwiriza atangwa n’Ubuyobozi
avugwa muri nomero 216 yavuzwe haruguru
akomeza gukurikizwa, hashingiwe kuri iryo
vugurura nk’uko rishobora gukurikizwa
hashingiwe kuri nimero ya 89 na 146 y’iri
Tegeko Shingiro kandi rigatangira
gukurikizwa. Ivugururwa iryo ari ryo ryose
ry’Amabwiriza atangwa n’Ubuyobozi ryaba
igice cyayo cyangwa yose, ritangira
gukurikizwa ku munsi cyangwa ku matariki
yavuzweho gusa ku bihugu bigize Umuryango
byamenyesheje Umunyamabanga mukuru ko
byemera gukurikiza iryo vugururwa, mbere
y’iyo tariki cyangwa ayo matariki. PP-98
217 (SUP) PP-98
217A 3 bis) ibihugu bigize Umuryango
byemera gukurikiza ivugururwa
ry’Amabwiriza atangwa n’Ubuyobozi, byaba
igice cyayo cyangwa yose, bishyikiriza
Umunyamabanga mukuru inyandiko yemeza
burundu, yemera iryo vugururwa cg iyo
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho
bikamenyesha Umunyamanga ko byemera
gukurikiza iryo vugururwa. PP-98
217B 3 ter) Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kigize
Umuryango gishobora kandi kumenyesha
Umunyamabanga mukuru ko kwemeza
burundu, kwemera amavugurura cyangwa
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye ku
ivugururwa ry’ iri Tegeko Shingiro cyangwa
ry’ Amasezerano hakurikijwe ingingo ya 55 y’
Itegeko Shingiro cyangwa iya 42
y’Amasezerano, bingana no kwemera ko
byemera gukurikiza ivugururwa iryo ari ryo
ryose ry’ Amabwiriza atangwa n’ Ubuyobozi,
ryaba igice cyayo cyangwa ryose, yemejwe n'
inama ibifitiye ububasha mbere yo gushyira
umukono ku mavugururwa avugwa kuri iri
Tegeko Shingiro cyangwa ku Masezerano. PP98
CS / Ingingo ya 54
217C 3 quater) Imenyekanisha rivugwa muri
nimero 217B yavuzwe haruguru rikorwa mu
gihe igihugu kigize Umuryango gitanze
inyandiko yacyo yemeza burundu, yemera
amavugurura cyangwa iyo kwemera kuba
kimwe mu bihuriye ku mavugururwa y’iri
Tegeko Shingiro cyangwa y’Amasezerano. PP98
217D 3 penter) Ivugururwa iryo ari ryo ryose
ry’Amabwiriza atangwa n’Ubuyobozi
ryubahirizwa by'agateganyo guhera itariki iryo
vugururwa ryatangiye gukurikizwa bitewe
n’igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kigize Umuryango
cyashyize umukono kuri iryo vugururwa kandi
kitamenyesheje Umunyamabanga mukuru ko
cyemera kubahiriza ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya
nimero 217A na 217B zavuzwe haruguru. Iryo
yubahirizwa ry’agateganyo rikurikizwa ari uko
igihugu kigize Umuryango kivugwa kitigeze
kibyanga mu gihe cyo gushyira umukono ku
ivugururwa. PP-98
218- 4 Iryo yuhahirizwa ry’agateganyo
rikomeza ku gihugu kigize Umuryango kugeza
igihe icyo gihugu kigize Umuryango
kimenyesheje Umunyamabanga mukuru
icyemezo cyacyo ko cyemera gukurikiza iryo
vugururwa. PP-98
219 kugeza kuri 221 (SUP) PP-98
221A 5 bis) Iyo igihugu kigize Umuryango
kitamenyesheje Umunyamabanga mukuru
icyemezo cyacyo ko cyemera gukurikiza
ivugururwa hakurikijwe nimero 218 yavuzwe
haruguru mu gihe cy’amezi mirongo itatu
n'atandatu uhereye ku itariki cyangwa amatariki
ivugururwa ryatangiye gukurikizwa, icyo
gihugu kigize Umuryango gifatwa nkaho
cyemera gukurikiza iryo vugururwa. PP-98
221B 5ter). Iyubahirizwa ry’agateganyo iryo
ari ryo ryose risobanurwa muri nimero 217D,
cyangwa ukwemera gukurikiza ivugururwa uko
ari ko kose gusobanurwa muri nimero 221A
kumvikana hitawe ku kwifata uko ari ko kose
igihugu bireba cyagombaga gukora mu gihe
cyashyiraga umukono ku ivugururwa.
Ukwemera gukurikiza nkuko bisobanuwe mu
nimero 216A, 217A, 217B na 218 zavuzwe
haruguru kumvikana hitawe ku kwifata uko ari
ko kose igihugu kigize Umuryango cyagombye
kuba cyaraakoze mu gihe cyo gushyira
umukono ku Mabwiriza avuguruye atangwa
n’Ubuyobozi cyangwa ivugururwa iryo ari ryo
ryose ryakozweho, icyo gihugu gipfa kuba
gikomeza ukwifata cyakoze mu gihe cyo
kumenyesha Umunyamabanga mukuru
ukwemera kwacyo ko gukurikiza ayo
Mabwiriza avuguruye. PP-98
222 (UP) PP-98
CS / Ingingo ya 55
223- 7 Umunyamabanga mukuru ashobora
kumenyesha bidatinze ibihugu bigize
Umuryango imenyekanisha ryose yakiriye
rijyanye n’iyi ngingo. PP-98

articles.heading: Ingingo zijyanye no kuvugurura iri Tegeko Shingiro 224- 1 Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kigize
articles.text:
Umuryango gishobora gusaba ivugururwa iryo
ari ryo ryose kuri iri Tegeko Shingiro. Icyifuzo
nk'icyo kigomba, kugira ngo gishobore
kugezwa ku bihugu byose bigize Umuryango
kandi bigisuzume mu gihe nyacyo, kugezwa ku
Munyamabanga mukuru bitarenze amezi
umunani mbere y’itariki yagenwe kuzaberaho
inama y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
n’ibihugu byabo. Umunyamabanga mukuru
atangaza icyo cyifuzo vuba bishoboka kandi
bitarenze amezi atandatu mbere y'iyo tariki
imaze kuvugwa, kugira ngo abimenyeshe
ibihugu byose bigize Umuryango. PP-98 PP02
225-2 Icyifuzo icyo ari cyo cyose cyo
guhindura ivugururwa cyatanzwe hakurikije
nimero 224 yavuzwe haruguru, gishobora
gutangwa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose n’igihugu
kigize Umuryango cyangwa intumwa zacyo mu
nama y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
n’ibihugu byabo. PP-98
226- 3 Umubare wa ngombwa usabwa mu
Nama y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu byabo yitabirwa n’abanyamuryango
bose kugira ngo hasuzumwe icyifuzo icyo ari
cyo cyose cyo kuvugurura iri Tegeko Shingiro
cyangwa guhindura icyo cyifuzo, uba uri hejuru
ya kimwe cya kabiri cy’intumwa zemerewe
kwitabira inama y’ababifitiye ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu byabo.
227- 4 Kugira ngo hemezwe, icyifuzo icyo ari
cyo cyose cyo guhindura ivugururwa
cyatanzwe, kimwe n’icyifuzo cy’ ivugururwa
uko ryakabaye, ryahinduwe cyangwa
ritahinduwe, kigomba kwemezwa, mu nama
yitabirwa n’intumwa z’ibihugu mu Nama
y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
byabo bangana nibura na bibiri bya gatatu
by’intumwa zemerewe kwitabira Inama
y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
byabo kandi zifite uburenganzira bwo gutora.
228- 5 Uretse igihe byaba bisobanuwe ukundi
mu bika bibanza by’iyi ngingo ari byo
byitabwaho, amategeko rusange agenga inama,
inteko n’inama z’Umuryango arakurikizwa.
PP-98 PP-02
CS / Ingingo ya 56
229- 6 Amavugururwa yose y’iri Tegeko
Shingiro yemejwe n’Inama y’ababifitiye
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu byabo, atangira
gukurikizwa ku munsi wagenwe n’Inama, yose
uko yakabaye kandi mu buryo bw’inyandiko
y’ivugururwa imwe rukumbi, hagati y’ibihugu
bigize Umuryango byamaze gutanga inyandiko
yabyo yo kwemeza burundu, kwemera
cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
bihuriye kuri iri Tegeko Shigiro no ku nyandiko
y’ivugururwa mbere y’iyo tariki. Kwemeza
burundu, kwemera cyangwa kwemera kuba
kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye ku gice kimwe gusa
cy’iyo nyandiko y’ivugururwa ntibyemewe.
PP-98
230- 7 Umunyamabanga mukuru amenyesha
ibihugu byose bigize Umuryango itangwa rya
buri nyandiko yo kwemeza burundu,
kuryemera cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe mu
bihugu birihuriyeho. PP-98
231- 8 Nyuma yo gutangira gukurikiza
inyandiko y’ivugururwa iryo ari ryo ryose,
kwemeza burundu, kuryemera cyangwa
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu birihuriyeho
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 52 n' iya 53 z'iri Tegeko
Shingiro bikurikizwa ku Itegeko Shingiro
rivuguruye.
232-9 Nyuma yo gutangira gukurikiza
inyandiko y’ivugururwa nk’iryo,
Umunyamabanga mukuru ayandikisha mu
Bunyamabanga bw’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye, hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’ingingo ya 102 y’Amasezerano
mpuzamahanga ashyiraho Umuryango
w’Abibumbye. Nimero 241 y’iri Tegeko
Shingiro ikoreshwa kandi ku nyandiko
y’ivugururwa iyo ari yo yose.

articles.heading: Gukemura amakimbirane 233- 1 Ibihugu bigize Umuryango bishobora gukemura amakimbirane bifitanye ku bibazo
articles.text:
bijyanye n’isobanurwa cyangwa iyubahirizwa
ry’iri Tegeko Shingiro, Amasezerano cyangwa
Amabwiriza atangwa n’Ubuyobozi, binyuze
mu nzira z’ibiganiro, mu nzira za dipolomasi
cyangwa hakurikijwe inzira zashyizweho
n’amasezerano hagati y’ibihugu bibiri cyangwa
byinshi yakozwe hagati yabyo mu rwego rwo
gukemura amakimbirane mpuzamahanga,
cyangwa binyuze mu bundi buryo ubwo ari
bwo bwose bishobora kumvikanaho. PP-98
CS / Ingingo ya 57
234- 2 Iyo nta buryo na bumwe bwo gukemura
amakimbirane bwemeranyijweho, igihugu
cyose kigize Umuryango kiri mu makimbirane
gishobora kwitabaza ubukemurampaka,
hakurikijwe inzira zisobanurwa mu
Masezerano. PP-98
235- 3 Amasezerano y’inyongera yo guhitamo
uburyo bwo gukemura amakimbirane ajyanye
n'iri Tegeko Shingiro, Amasezerano
n'amabwiriza atangwa n’ubuyobozi
arakurikizwa hagati y’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango biri muri ayo Masezerano
y’inyongera. PP-98

articles.heading: Ukwivana muri iri Tegeko Shingiro n’Amasezerano 236- 1 Buri gihugu kigize Umuryango cyemeje
articles.text:
burundu, cyemeye iri Tegeko Shingiro
n’Amasezerano cyangwa byemeranyijweho
bifite uburenganzira bwo kubyivanamo. Muri
icyo gihe, kwivana muri iri Tegeko Shingiro
n’Amasezerano bikorerwa icyarimwe mu
buryo bw’inyandiko imwe rukumbi,
bimenyeshejwe Umunyamabanga mukuru.
Umunyamabanga mukuru amaze kubona ayo
makuru, abimenyesha ibindi bihugu bigize
Umuryango. PP-98
237- 2 Uko kwivanamo gutangira kugira
agaciro iyo igihe cy’umwaka umwe kirangiye
uhereye igihe Umunyamabanga mukuru
yabimenyesherejwe.

articles.heading: Gutangira gukurikizwa n’ibibazo bijyanye na byo 238- 1 Iri Tegeko Shingiro n’Amasezerano, byemejwe n’inama y’inyongera y’ababifitiye
articles.text:
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu byabo (Geneve,
1992), bizatangira kubahirizwa ku wa 1
Nyakanga 1994 hagati y’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango bizaba byamaze gutanga inyandiko
zabyo zo kubyemeza burundu, kubyemera
cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
bibihuriyeho mbere y’ iyo tariki. PP-02
CS / Ingingo ya 58
239- 2 Ku itariki yo gutangira gukurikizwa
igaragazwa muri nimero ya 238 yavuzwe
haruguru, iri Tegeko Shingiro n’Amasezerano
bikuraho kandi bisimbura, hagati y’ibihugu
bibihuriyeho, Amasezerano mpuzamahanga
y’itumanaho ya (Nairobi 1982).
240- 3 Hakurikijwe ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 102
y’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ashyiraho
Umuryango w’Abibumbye, Umunyamabanga
mukuru wawo yandikisha iri Tegeko Shingiro
n’Amasezerano mu bunyamabanga
bw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye.
241- 4 Umwimerere w'iri Tegeko Shingiro
n'Amasezerano washyizwe mu Cyongereza,
Icyarabu, Igishinwa, Icyesipanyolo, Igifaransa
n'Ikirusiya bikomeza kubikwa mu
ishyinguranyandiko ry’Umuryango.
Umunyamabanga mukuru yoherereza, mu
ndimi zasabwe, inyandukuro ihuje
n’umwimerere buri gihugu kigize Umuryango
cyarishyizeho umukono. PP-98
242- 5 Mu gihe habaye ukudahuza uko ari ko
kose cyangwa kuvuguruzanya, hagati
y’inyandiko z’iri Tegeko Shingiro
n’Amasezerano mu ndimi zitandukanye,
inyandiko y’igifaransa ni yo yitabwaho.
UMUGEREKA:
Ibisobanuro by'amagambo amwe n'amwe
akoreshwa muri iri Tegeko Shingiro, mu
Masezerano no mu Mabwiriza atangwa
n’ubuyobozi bw’Umuryango mpuzamahanga
w’itumanaho
1001 Ku bw’intego z’inyandiko z’Umuryango
zavuzwe haruguru, amagambo akurikira
agomba kuba afite ubusobanuro nkuko
bwatanzwe ahakurikira:
1001A Igihugu kigize Umuryango: Igihugu
gifatwa nk’ikigize Umuryango mpuzamahanga
w’Itumanaho hubahirizwa ibiteganywa
n’ingingo ya 2 y’iri Tegeko Shingiro. PP-98
1001B Umunyamuryango w’urwego: Ikigo
cyangwa umuryango byemerewe, hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 19 y’Amasezerano
mu kugira uruhare mu bikorwa by’urwego. PP98
1002 Ubuyobozi: Serivisi iyo ari yo yose ya
Leta cyangwa ishami rya Leta rishinzwe gufata
ibyemezo mu rwego rwo gusohoza inshingano
z’Itegeko Shingiro ry’Umuryango
mpuzamahanga w’Itumanaho, Amasezerano
y’Umuryango mpuzamahanga w’Itumanaho
n’amabwiriza atangwa n’ubuyobozi.
1003 Ukwivanga kw’imirongo: ukwivanga
kubangamira imikorere ya serivisi y’imirongo
insakazamajwi ivugiraho cyangwa izindi
serivisi z’umutekano cyangwa kugabanya
cyane ukumvikana, kugakura ku murongo
inshuro nyinshi cyangwa kukabuza imikorere
ya serivisi y’itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi zikoreshwa hakurikijwe
amabwiriza agenga itumanaho rikoresha
insakazamajwi.
1004 ihererekanya makuru rusange:
Itumanaho iryo ari ryo ryose ibiro n’ibigo
by’itangazamakuru, mu rwego rwo kugira ngo
bigere ku baturage, bisabwa kwemera kugira
ngo ubutumwa butambuke.
1005 Intumwa: Intumwa zose kandi,
bishoboka ko baba abahagarariye ibihugu,
abajyanama, abakorera inzego z’ubuyobozi
cyangwa abasemuzi boherejwe n’igihugu
kimwe mu bigize Umuryango. PP-98
Buri gihugu kigize Umuryango gifite
uburenganzira bwo kugena intumwa zacyo uko
gishaka. By' umwihariko, hashobora kuba
hakubiyemo mu ntumwa zacyo, nk’
abajyanama cyangwa abakozi b’inzego
z’ubuyobozi, abantu bo mu kigo icyo ari cyo
cyose cyangwa umuryango wemewe
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n'Amasezerano
bijyanye.
1006 Intumwa: Umuntu woherejwe na
guverinoma y’igihugu kigize Umuryango mu
nama y’ababifitiye ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu byabo, cyangwa umuntu uhagarariye
guverinoma cyangwa ubuyobozi bw’igihugu
kigize Umuryango mu yindi nama cyangwa mu
nama y’Umuryango. PP-98
1007 ikigo gikora: Umuntu ku giti cye,
isosiyete, ikigo cyangwa ikigo cyose cya Leta
gikoresha ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu
itumanaho kigamije gutanga serivisi
z’itumanaho mpuzamahanga cyangwa
gishobora gutera ukwivanga kw’imirongo muri
serivisi nk’iyo.
1008 Ikigo gikora cyemewe na Leta: Ikigo
icyo ari cyo cyose nk’uko byasobanuwe
haruguru, gikoresha serivisi y’ihererekanya
makuru rusange cyangwa serivisi
z’itangazamakuru kandi kirebwa n’ibisabwa
biteganywa n’ingingo ya 6 y’iri Tegeko
Shingiro bishyirwaho n’igihugu kigize
Umuryango kirimo icyicaro cy’icyo kigo
cyangwa bishyirwaho n’igihugu kigize
Umuryango cyemereye icyo kigo gushyiraho
no gukora serivisi y’itumanaho ku butaka
bwacyo. PP-98
1009 Itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi:
itumanaho rikoresha imirongo insakazamajwi
ivugiraho.
1010 Serivisi yo gutangaza amakuru: Serivisi
y’itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi ritanga
ibiganiro bigenewe ako kanya abaturage muri
rusange. Iyo serivisi ishobora kuba irimo
ibiganiro bitangwa hakoreshejwe amajwi,
ibiganiro bitangwa hakoreshejwe amajwi
n’amashusho cyangwa ubundi bwoko
bw’ibiganiro.
1011 Serivisi mpuzamahanga y'itumanaho:
itangwa rya serivisi y'itumanaho hagati y'ibiro
cyangwa ibigo by’itangazamakuru by'ubwoko
bwose by’ibihugu bitandukanye cyangwa
biherereye mu bihugu bitandukanye.
1012 Itumanaho: igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose
cyo gutambutsa ubutumwa, ibiganiro cyangwa
kwakira amakuru mu buryo bw’ibimenyetso,
inyandiko, amashusho, amajwi cyangwa
ikusanyamakuru ry’ubwoko bwose,
hakoreshejwe insinga, insakazamajwi,
itumanaho rikoresha amashanyarazi cyangwa
ubundi buryo budakoresha insinga.
1013 Ubutumwa: inyandiko igomba
koherezwa hakoreshejwe itumanaho rikoresha
kode kugira ngo bugere ku bo bugenewe. Iri
jambo rikubiyemo na none ubutumwa
bwatanzwe hakoreshejwe insakazamajwi,
keretse iyo ryasobanuwe ukundi.
1014 Itumanaho rya Leta: ubutumwa
buturuka ku:
- umukuru w'igihugu;
- umuyobozi wa guverinoma cyangwa abagize
guverinoma;
- umugaba mukuru w' ingabo zo ku butaka, mu
mazi cyangwa mu kirere;
- abadipolomate cyangwa abahagarariye
ibihugu byabo;
- Umunyamabanga mukuru w’ Umuryango
w’Abibumbye; abayobozi b'inzego zigize
Umuryango w' Abibumbye;
- Urukiko mpuzamahanga, cyangwa ubutumwa
busubiza itumanaho rya Leta twavuze
haruguru.
1015 Ubutumwa bwigenga: Ubundi butumwa
butari ubwa Leta cyangwa ubwa serivisi.
1016 Itumanaho rikoresha kode: Imiterere
y'itumanaho aho amakuru yatanzwe agomba
kwandikwa akigera aho ajya mu buryo
bw'inyandiko za kode; aya makuru ashobora
gutangwa mu bundi buryo cyangwa kwandikwa
kugira ngo azakoreshwe ikindi gihe.
Icyitonderwa: Inyandiko ya kode ibika
amakuru yanditse, acapye cyangwa mu ishusho
ihamye mu buryo burambye, kandi ishobora
kuba yabikwa no kwifashishwa.
1017 Itumanaho rikoresha telefoni: Uburyo
bw’itumanaho rigamije cyane cyane
guhanahana amakuru mu buryo bwo kuvuga.
